blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models increasingly replace real people in the AI development pipeline, as they are used to generate training dialogues at scale and to drive alignment and evaluation. However, out-of-the-box models produce monolingual and stylistically flat texts as synthetic user prompts, failing to replicate the real user-AI communication mechanics. We present PersonaFactory, an end-to-end pipeline that generates detailed user personas and uses them to augment existing user prompts from their point of view, producing a bank of over 740000 structured synthetic personas detailing their background and communication behaviors, and a corpus of roughly 1.24 million persona-styled synthetic conversations spanning 85 languages. We evaluate the effect of personal features on style adoption and intent preservation, using an LLM-judge and heuristic metrics to assess augmentation fidelity together with the downstream impact on assistant persona control through training data. Results show that our structured, attribute-based style representation enables per-axis control and better intent preservation at comparable style fidelity than free-text persona descriptions used in existing methods. A human expert evaluation found the augmented conversations plausible, with favorable ratings for intent preservation, style naturalness, and multilingual authenticity. Finally, PersonaFactory conversations achieve comparable performance to original training data on capability benchmarks, are preferred on real user prompts at equal reply length, and adapt their reply style more closely to users without explicit steering.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模式越来越多地取代AI开发管道中的真实人员,因为这些模式被用于形成规模化的训练对话并驱动校正和评价. 然而,出箱模型作为合成用户的提示,产生单语言和风格平坦的文本,未能复制真正的用户-AI通信力学. 我们介绍PersonaFactory,一个端到端的管道,生成详细的用户人物并利用它们从他们的角度来增强现有的用户提示,生成一个超过740000个结构化合成人的银行,详细介绍他们的背景和交流行为,以及大约124万个人形合成对话,涵盖85种语言。 我们评估个人特征对采用风格和意向保护的影响,使用LLM法官和高压衡量标准评估增强忠诚度,以及通过培训数据对助理人员控制产生的下游影响。 结果显示,我们的结构化的、基于属性的风格表现使得每个轴能够控制,并且比现有方法中使用的自由文字人物描述更能保持相似的风格忠诚。 一项人类专家评价认为,增加的对话是可信的,对意图保全、风格自然和多语种真实性给予有利的评价。 最后,PersonaFactory对话实现了与能力基准原始培训数据的可比较性能,在真实的用户提示上首选了相同的回执长度,并在没有明确引导的情况下更紧密地适应用户的回执风格.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Conversational datasets are integral to large language model development, shaping how models understand users’ intents and behave in diverse settings. Existing open-source datasets largely focus on LLM-generated synthetic setups because human-based data scaling is cost- and time-intensive. Therefore, AI is now used in all stages of training other models on real-life interaction with human users. This includes user questions and assistant responses, judging the quality of such QA pairs, and evaluating model effectiveness in chat interaction settings. However, this scalability comes at the cost of authenticity and diversity: the raw material for most simulated users is the same narrow band of text: instruction-tuning corpora written in a homogeneous, well-punctuated, standard-register “assistant/user” voice. The result is one averaged user who is monolingual, verbose and stylistically uniform, a narrow reflection of real users across cultures, languages and behaviors. Such datasets, widely used to train open models, lack non-native phrasing, code-switching, terse or lowercase typing, and dialectal variation, giving a narrow picture of how users actually communicate with AI in real-life conditions.
blocks.zh: 对话数据集是大型语言模型开发所不可或缺的,它塑造了模型如何理解用户的用意,如何在不同环境中的行为. 现有的开源数据集主要侧重于LLM所生成的合成设置,因为以人为基础的数据缩放成本和时间都比较高. 因此,AI现在被用于培训其他模式与人类用户进行现实互动的所有阶段。 这包括用户提问和助手回答,判断这种QA对的质量,以及评价聊天互动设置中的模型有效性. 然而,这种可伸缩性是以真实性和多样性为代价的:大多数模拟用户的原材料是相同的狭义文本:用同质、平整、标准注册的“协助者/用户”的语音写出的指示-调音。 结果是一个平均使用者是单一语言,动词和风格统一的,对真正使用者在文化,语言和行为上的狭义反映. 此类数据集被广泛用于训练开放模型,缺乏非本土用词,代码切换,terse或小写打字,以及方言变异,给出了用户在现实生活中实际与AI沟通的狭义画面.

blocks.en: Figure 1: The PersonaFactory pipeline. An existing conversation (a real WildChat log or a synthetic UltraChat or Nemotron seed) is matched to a compatible user-simulator profile; user turns are rewritten in that profile’s voice with the request held fixed, and assistant turns are regenerated correspondingly.
blocks.zh: 图1:Persona Factory管道。 现有的对话(一个真实的WildChat日志或合成的UltraChat或Nemotron种子)被匹配到兼容的用户-模拟器配置图;用户转动被重写在该配置图的语音中被固定地所持请求,助手转动被相应再生成.

blocks.en: When simulating conversations, there are two common design pitfalls: (1) methods that simulate personalized conversations from scratch condition on short persona descriptions and underuse the background details that most shape content and style; (2) rewriting existing conversations preserves the original intent but changes little in how the text reads. Grounding conversations between a user and the AI assistant in a pre-generated persona presents an opportunity to address this, with related existing work on synthetic persona generation; however, persona descriptions are usually limited to a 2–5 short sentence summary or lack information about behavior in a chatbot setting. Compressing the user’s full background into a short description may change what the user is saying, but not how , as it does not focus on their writing style.
blocks.zh: 在模拟对话时,有两种常见的设计陷阱:(1)在短人物描述上从划痕条件模拟个性化对话的方法并低估了大多数形状内容和风格的背景细节;(2)对现有对话的改写保留了原意,但文本读取方式变化不大. 将用户和AI助手的对话定位在预先生成的人a中,为解决这个问题提供了一个机会,与合成人生成相关的现有工作;然而,人称描述通常仅限于2–5个短句摘要,或者缺乏关于聊天器环境中的行为的信息. 将用户的全部背景压缩为简短的描述可能会改变用户的意思,但不会改变方式,因为它并不注重他们的写作风格.

blocks.en: We present PersonaFactory , a pipeline to target these particular issues in synthetic persona and chat data generation (Figure 1 ). The key idea is to keep the original dialogue trajectory from an existing real or synthetic conversation, but re-simulate the user side under a structured synthetic persona: the request stays fixed, while the register, typing style, and language behavior match those of a simulated user drawn from a large, controllable population. The persona description covers not only basic information such as age, origin, occupation, and a short biography, but also writing style, linguistic quirks, digital fluency and AI stance, painting a much richer background on how the persona would interact with an AI model. Since the intervention is a constrained rewrite of existing user turns (real WildChat user logs and synthetic UltraChat and Nemotron seeds) rather than free generation, it keeps the original requests and dialogue trajectories while gaining the diversity and authenticity from the user’s side.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍PersonaFactory,这是针对合成人和聊天数据生成中这些特定问题的管道(图1)。 关键的想法是将原始对话轨迹从现有的真实或合成的对话中保持下来,但在结构化的合成人a下重新模拟用户方:请求保持不变,而寄存器,打字风格,语言行为则与从大可控人群中抽取的模拟用户相匹配. 人物描述不仅包括了年龄,出身,职业等基本信息以及短篇传记,还包括写作风格,语言怪异,数字流利和AI姿态等,描绘了更丰富的人物与AI模型互动的背景. 由于该干预是对现有用户转折(真实的WildChat用户日志和合成的UltraChat和Nemotron种子)的受限重写,而不是自由生成,因此它保留了原始请求和对话轨迹,同时从用户一方获得多样性和真实性.

blocks.en: To improve the fidelity of user simulation, we introduce three components, which also represent the principal contributions of this paper:
blocks.zh: 为了提高用户模拟的可靠性,我们提出了三个组成部分,它们也是本文件的主要贡献:

blocks.en: 1. A structured user-simulator profile schema and a bank of over 740000 profiles (Section 3 ). Each profile has a background layer (geography, occupation, education, age, native language, AI stance, digital fluency) and a style layer (capitalization, punctuation, emoji, typos, abbreviation habits, code-switching, quirks, and a verbatim example message). Profiles are grounded on a manually-curated country, sub-region, and occupation grid with region-decoupled occupations and sector-coherent fluency, generated by three open LLMs and screened by an independent judge. The pipeline can also extend existing persona banks with style axis information, improving the quality of downstream seeded data. 2. 1.2M persona-augmented conversations from a grounded simulation pipeline (Section 4 ) that (i) conservatively matches a language- and script-compatible persona to each log, refusing to assign a persona rather than risk a language mismatch; (ii) rewrites user turns to preserve the exact request, constraints, and language while adopting persona style; and (iii) regenerates assistant turns with next-turn continuity supervision , using the real follow-up user message as weak supervision that the simulated turn stays on-trajectory, followed by a six-class sanity gate. 3. An intrinsic evaluation of simulation fidelity (Section 5 ) separating style adoption from intent preservation , with position-bias and multi-judge controls, and complemented by judge-free corpus-scale metrics (embedding similarity, edit depth, and rule-based entity and style checks). Our headline finding is that a structured per-axis style representation is preferred over a free-text style description on style fidelity, while both preserve intent equally; at matched content and length, structure keeps the request more often and reads more naturally at comparable style (Appendix D ).
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 结构化的用户模拟剖面图和超过740 000个剖面图的库(第3节)。 每个剖面图都有背景层(地理学,职业,教育,年龄,本土语言,AI姿势,数字流利)和风格层(资本化,平分,emoji,twos,缩写习惯,代码切换,奇特克语,和逐字记录等). 概况以人工确定的国家、分地区和职业网为基础,与区域脱钩的职业和部门协调流利,由三个开放式有限责任公司产生并由独立法官筛选。 管道还可以以样式轴信息来扩展现有的人物库,提高下游种子数据的质量. 2. 1.2M persona-aignated conversation from a bound simulation project(第4节),即(一) 保守地将语言和脚本相容的人物a与每个日志相匹配,拒绝指定一个人物,而不是冒着语言不匹配的风险;(二) 重写用户在采用人物作风时,转而保留确切的请求、约束和语言;以及(三) 将助手转而进行下一轮的连续监督,将真正的后续用户信息作为薄弱的监督,使模拟转而停留在轨道上,然后是六级的神智门。 3. 对模拟忠诚性进行内在评价(第5节),将采用风格与意图保全区分开来,有立场偏好和多法官控制,并辅以法官免起诉尺度的衡量标准(包含相似性、编辑深度、基于规则的实体和风格检查)。 我们头条的发现是,结构化的每轴样式代表比风格忠贞的自由文字样式描述更受青睐,同时既要平等地保留意向;在相匹配的内容和长度上,结构更经常地保留请求并更自然地以可比较的风格来阅读(Appendix D.

Each profile has a background layer (geography, occupation, education, age, native language, AI stance, digital fluency) and a style layer (capitalization, punctuation, emoji, typos, abbreviation habits, code-switching, quirks, and a verbatim example message). Profiles are grounded on a manually-curated country, sub-region, and occupation grid with region-decoupled occupations and sector-coherent fluency, generated by three open LLMs and screened by an independent judge. The pipeline can also extend existing persona banks with style axis information, improving the quality of downstream seeded data.

blocks.en: We also conduct a preliminary multilingual expert evaluation of the generated conversations to examine their naturalness and authenticity (Appendix E ). We release the persona bank, augmented conversation corpus, and pipeline code to support further research on persona-conditioned conversational data generation.
blocks.zh: 我们还对所产生的对话进行初步的多语种专家评价,以审查对话的自然性和真实性(附录E)。 我们发布了个人银行, 增强对话程序, 和管道代码, 支持进一步研究 个人有条件的对话数据生成。

blocks.en: 2 Background and Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 背景和有关工作

blocks.en: LLM-based user simulation has largely replaced agenda-based simulators ( Ni et al., 2026 ) , either by training purpose-built user models ( Naous et al., 2026 ; Kong et al., 2024 ; Sun et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025a ) or by optimizing simulators with reinforcement learning ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Qian et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) ; a parallel persona-conditioned line, from PersonaChat ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) to role-play agents ( Tseng et al., 2024 ; Samuel et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ) , conditions generation on short biographical profiles. Across both lines, the simulated user remains generic: an averaged user served as a live, hard-to-audit model, with personas that say who a character is but not how they type, and the behavior distribution becomes skewed and hard to control ( Li et al., 2026 ) . PersonaFactory instead rewrites existing logs under a quality-gated persona population with a first-class style layer, and releases a curated corpus rather than a simulator. User-simulator benchmarks such as MirrorBench ( Hathidara et al., 2026 ) and SimulatorArena ( Dou et al., 2025 ) score free-generated user turns; they do not fit persona-conditioned rewriting, where the seed fixes the request and only the voice changes, so we evaluate style adoption and intent preservation against the seed. Concurrent work ( Konnelly et al., 2026 ) also authors personas as sociolinguistic style profiles.
blocks.zh: 基于 LLM 的用户模拟器已基本取代基于议事日程的模拟器 (Ni等,2026年),通过培训专门设计的用户模型(Naous等,2026年;Kong等,2024年;Sun等,2024年;Wang等,2025年a),或通过优化模拟器进行强化学习(Wang等,2026年;Qian等,2025年;Zhang等,2026年;Persona的一条平行人称条件线路)。 Chat (Zhang等,2018年)到角色扮演代理(Tseng等,2024年;Samuel等,2025年;Wang等,2025年b),为短篇生平简介创造条件. 在这两行中,模拟用户仍然是通用的:一个平均用户充当了活的,难于审计的模型,其中人物称谁是角色,但不是他们如何打字,行为分布变得扭曲并难以控制(Li等,2026年). PersonaFactory转而将现存的日志重写在一个质量高的人物群下,具有一等风格层,并释放出一个被编程而并非模拟器. 用户-模拟基准如Mirgor Bench(Hathidara等,2026年)和Simulatorarena(Dou等,2025年)评分自由生成的用户转会;它们不适应人-条件重写,种子会修正请求而只改变语音,因此我们评价样式的通过和对种子的意向保护. 同时期作品 (Konnelly等, 2026) 也作为社会语言风格简介的作者人物.

blocks.en: Large persona datasets are largely used to improve synthetic training data ( Ge et al., 2025 ; Meyer and Corneil, 2025 ; Ma et al., 2026 ; Ryan et al., 2025 ) , on top of persona-free recipes ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Ding et al., 2023 ) , and real-log sources ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) . However, adding a persona influences the content of the data. At the same time, the style remains in the same generic voice, as the persona itself is usually a one- to two-sentence free-text description that underspecifies typing behavior. Methodologically, the closest work is SynthPAI ( Yukhymenko et al., 2024 ) , which seeds LLM agents with structured profiles, including a description of writing style, to generate realistic Reddit threads as the privacy-preserving alternative to attribute inference evaluation of Staab et al. (2024) . However, SynthPAI targets user-user interaction rather than user-AI chat. We build on this idea of a separate style entity: we decompose the style description into structured per-axis keys, which the judge prefers on style at equal prompt length (Section 5 ) and which keep the request more often at matched content (Appendix D ); we ground generation in existing logs with the original intent fixed rather than generating from scratch, and decouple occupation from region to suppress stereotypes (Section 3 ).
blocks.zh: 大型人文数据集主要用于改进合成培训数据(Ge等,2025;Meyer和Corneil,2025;Ma等,2026;Ryan等,2025;),以无人食谱为主(Wang等,2023;Ding等,2023;),和真文献出处. (赵等,2024). 然而,增加一个人a会影响数据的内容。 同时,风格仍保持同一种通俗的语音,因为人物本身通常是一至二刑的自由文字描述,低估了打字行为. 从方法上来说,最接近的作品是SynthPAI(Yukhymenko等,2024年),它种子具有结构化剖面的LLM剂,包括写作风格的描述,以产生现实的Reddit线条,作为Staab等的属性推论评价的隐私保护替代. (2024年). 然而,SynthPAI针对的是用户-用户交互,而不是用户-AI聊天. 我们基于这种单独风格实体的想法:我们把风格描述分解成结构化的每轴键,法官倾向于在等速长度上采用风格(第5节),并且更经常地将请求与相应内容相匹配(附录D);我们用原有意图固定而不是从零开始的现有日志进行地面生成,并且从区域中将职业脱钩以压制定型观念(第3节)。

blocks.en: Argyle et al. (2023) propose four criteria for whether model samples stand in for human ones (Turing test, backward and forward continuity, pattern correspondence); Pagan et al. (2026) show that LLM text stays distinguishable from human text for a trained classifier, trading human-likeness against semantic fidelity. Our pipeline keeps the request, so it sits on the fidelity side; Appendix C evaluates all four criteria and both detector settings.
blocks.zh: Argyle等人(2023年)提出了模型样本是否适用于人类的四项标准(图灵测试,后向和前向连续性,图案对应);Pagan等人(2026年)表明,LLM文本对于训练有素的分类器来说仍然与人类文本相区别,与语义上的忠诚相交易. 我们的管道保持请求,所以它坐落在忠诚的一面;附录C评价所有四个标准以及两个探测器设置.

blocks.en: Dialect and register variation is known to degrade and bias NLP systems ( Blodgett et al., 2016 ; Ziems et al., 2022 ) , and persona prompting alone induces only limited diversity ( Kambhatla et al., 2025 ) ; yet the synthetic pipelines producing today’s conversational training data barely vary register, so the variation these systems handle worst is exactly what their training data lacks. PersonaFactory makes this variation (code-switching, typo tendency, capitalization, digital fluency) the explicit object of simulation, as conditioning variables rather than claims of dialect authenticity.
blocks.zh: 据了解,分辨和登记变异会降解和偏向NLP系统(Blodgett等,2016年;Ziems等,2022年),而个人单调只会引起有限的多样性(Kambhatla等,2025年);然而,制作今天的谈话培训数据的合成管道几乎没有变化,因此这些系统处理最差的变化正是其培训数据所缺乏的。 PersonaFactory将这种变异(代码切换,类型趋势,资本化,数字流利)作为模拟的明显对象,作为条件变量,而不是声称方言的真实性.

blocks.en: 3 Scaling the PersonaFactory Bank with Realistic Synthetic Personas
blocks.zh: 3 用现实合成人放大个人事实银行

blocks.en: First, we describe the synthetic profile generation pipeline, which produces a highly diverse bank of over 740000 personas (743,010), focused not only on users’ backgrounds but also on their communication style in a human-AI setting.
blocks.zh: 首先,我们描述了合成剖面图生成管道,它产生了一个高度多样化的有740 000多个人的库(743 010),不仅侧重于用户的背景,而且侧重于他们在人与AI环境下的交流风格。

blocks.en: We split the persona representation into two layers: background and style . The background layer provides information on age (adults only, 18–80 in the generated bank, as we find simulating underage personas unethical), gender, country/region of origin, occupation (with sector), education, native language (with regional dialect), hobbies, AI stance and digital fluency level. Based on this background, we condition the generation of the style layer, covering sentence-length tendency, question framing, native-language error patterns, code-switching frequency and type, a cultural reference pool, a structured seven-key chatting style (capitalization, punctuation, emoji use, abbreviation habits, typo tendency, message structure, sign-offs), several (2–4) linguistic quirks, and an example message the persona would usually type. Separating them lets us use the first layer for content adjustment and the second layer to change how it will be written (Section 4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们把人物代表分成两层:背景和风格。 背景层提供年龄(仅成人,在生成的银行中为18-80岁,因为我们发现模拟未成年者是不道德的)、性别、原籍国/地区、职业(与部门)、教育、母语(与地区方言)、爱好、AI立场和数字流利程度。 基于这一背景,我们设定了样式层的生成条件,涵盖句长趋势,问题框架,本地语言出错模式,代码切换频率和类型,文化参考池,结构化的七键聊天风格(资本化,平分化,emoji使用,缩写习惯,打字倾向,消息结构,签出),数个(2–4)语言怪语,以及人物通常会打出的例子信息. 分离它们让我们用第一层来调整内容,第二层来改变其写作方式(第4节)。

blocks.en: We pass the pre-defined JSON schema into the generator and use it to produce N N personas in the specified format. As generator models, we used Gemma-4-31B ( Team et al., 2026 ) , Ministral-3-14B ( Liu et al., 2026 ) and GLM-4.7-Flash ( GLM-4.5 Team et al., 2025 ) , balancing each model’s geographical and multilingual strengths for various regions; the model selection is equally balanced across generator models. We ground the generation in a manually curated set of 177 countries and 599 sub-regions, combined with 575 concrete occupations spanning 23 sectors (details in Appendix A ). We sample occupations independently of origin region to avoid biased profiles, which we initially observed (e.g., for Switzerland, the most popular occupation would be watchmaker or software engineer; Eastern Europe and Asia are more agriculture-heavy). Moreover, digital fluency is matched to the occupation sector to ensure realistic backgrounds. The style layer is filled in the same generation pass. Still, it is explicitly conditioned on the already-sampled background: the generation prompt (Appendix B.1 ) instructs the generator to derive each style attribute from the persona’s age, education, digital fluency, and native language, choosing every structured key from a fixed set of options that must stay consistent with the free-text style sentence and the verbatim example message. Profiles with a degenerate style layer, that is, a missing style description, fewer than two linguistic quirks, no example message, or empty structured keys, are rejected outright before judging.
blocks.zh: 我们把预定义的JSON schema传递到生成器中,并用它以指定格式生产出N Personas. 作为发电机模型,我们使用了Gemma-4-31B (Team等,2026年),Ministry-3-14B (Liu等,2026年)和GLM-4.7-Flash(GLM-4.5 Team等,2025年),平衡了每个模型在各地区的地域和多语言优势;模型选择在生成模型之间是同等平衡的. 我们把这一代人安置在一套由177个国家和599个分地区人工管理,再加上涉及23个部门的575个具体职业(详见附录A)。 我们从原籍地区中独立抽取职业,以避免出现偏见,我们最初观察到这一点(例如,在瑞士,最受欢迎的职业是制表人或软件工程师;东欧和亚洲农业比较重)。 此外,数字流畅与占领部门相匹配,以确保现实背景。 风格层被填入同代传入. 尽管如此,它明确地以已经被验证的背景为条件: 生成提示 (Appendix B.1 ) 指示生成者从人物的年龄,教育,数字流畅度,以及本土语言中得出每个样式属性,从一组固定选项中选择每个结构化的密钥,这些选项必须与自由文本样式句子和逐字记录句保持一致. 带有退化风格层的配置,即缺少样式描述,不到两个语言奇特,没有实例信息,或空结构密钥,在判断前会被直接拒绝.

blocks.en: An independent judge ( MiniMax-M2.5 ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , not one of the generators, avoiding self-preference) scores every profile on internal coherence, occupation/location plausibility, LLM-user authenticity, stereotype severity, and realism, with a two-pass repair that corrects implausibly low fluency for technical roles and rewrites age-incoherent job titles before re-judging. The gate is strict but rarely triggered: about 95% of generated profiles are kept, judged realism is high, and only 0.2% of profiles are flagged for non-trivial stereotype severity. Appendix A (Table 4 ) provides full coverage, demographic, and per-generator quality statistics.
blocks.zh: 独立法官(MiniMax-M2.5 (Chen等,2026年)),不是发电机之一,避免自首)在内部一致性,职业/位置合理性,LLM用户真实性,定型严重性,现实性等方面评分,采用双通修补,在重新判断前纠正技术角色的低流性,并重写年龄不一致的职称. 该门很严格但很少被触发:大约95%生成的剖面图被保存下来,判断现实主义很高,只有0.2%的剖面图被标出非三角定型严重性. 附录A(表4)提供了全面覆盖、人口统计和每代人质量统计。

blocks.en: 4 Prompt Augmentation using Synthetic Personas
blocks.zh: 4 利用合成人进行快速增强

blocks.en: A grounded user simulator must satisfy four requirements: (R1) preserve the real task and its constraints, defaulting to its language; (R2) express sociolinguistic diversity beyond the standard register; (R3) stay on the logged conversation’s trajectory; and (R4) remain auditable and leakage-free, so that models trained on it learn no hidden persona shortcut. PersonaFactory’s four stages map onto these requirements: conservative matching and constrained rewriting serve R1, cross-lingual selection and structured style layer serve R2, next-turn continuity supervision serves R3, and storing only observable turns serves R4. We illustrate the pipeline in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh: 一个被禁用用户模拟器必须满足四项要求:(R1) 保留真实的任务及其限制, 默认使用它的语言;(R2) 表达标准注册表以外的社会语言多样性;(R3) 保持记录的对话轨迹;和(R4) 保持可审计性和无渗漏性,这样,对其进行培训的模型不会学习隐藏人物的捷径. PersonaFactory在这些要求上的四个阶段的映射: 保守匹配和受限重写服务R1, 跨语言选择和结构化风格层服务R2, 下个回合连续性监督服务R3, 并存储仅可观察到的转折服务R4. 我们在图1中说明了管道。

blocks.en: We first detect the language and script of the initial user turn using deterministic Unicode block classifiers (covering CJK, Cyrillic, Arabic, etc.) coupled with a confidence-thresholded language detector. 2 2 2 https://github.com/pemistahl/lingua-py To serve distinct research needs, the pipeline operates under two selection regimes: 1. Conservative (Language-Matched) Selection: A persona is eligible only if it is verified to communicate natively in the prompt’s language and script. Non-Latin prompts are mapped strictly to native-speaking personas sharing the target script, non-English Latin prompts to detected-language personas, and English prompts to the broader English-speaking pool. A single best-matching persona is retrieved through prioritized tiers: geographic location matching, top-1 semantic embedding cosine similarity, or deterministic language-pool fallback. If no compatible persona exists, the pipeline returns the original turn verbatim. 2. Cross-Lingual Diverse Selection: To reflect authentic multilingual populations who interact with LLMs in global languages, this mode samples a single persona uniformly at random from the entire bank (where native-English personas constitute only 19.6%), allowing non-English personas to re-voice prompts with their regional register, cultural framing, and loanwords while relaxing strict script-stability abort gates. Exact-format prompts (e.g., verbatim reproduction, code generation tasks, direct translation, and strict JSON/quoted output instructions) are automatically detected and bypassed by format guards. In a controlled pilot, conservative matching raises style adoption by more than 20 points over a random persona of the same language (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 我们首先使用确定Unicode区块分类器(覆盖CJK,西里尔语,阿拉伯语等)来检测初始用户回合的语言和脚本. 2 2 2 2 https://github.com/pemistahl/lingua-py 为了满足不同的研究需要,管道在两种选择制度下运作: 1. 保守派(语言学) 选择 : 一个人a 只有在被证实以当事者的语言和脚本进行本土交流时才有资格。 非拉丁语的提示被严格地映射到讲本地语的人共享目标脚本,非英语拉丁语的提示被检测到语言的人,英语的提示被映射到更广泛的英语池. 通过优先等级检索出单一的最佳匹配人a:地理位置相匹配、上一语义嵌入同位素相似性,或确定性语言库倒置。 如果不存在相容的人物a,则管道返回原转盘逐字记录. 2. 跨部门 不同选择 : 为了反映以全球语言与LLMS互动的真实的多语言人群,这个模式从整个银行中随机抽取一个单一的人a(当地人-英语人仅占19.6%),允许非英语人用他们的区域注册、文化框架和出借词重新发出提示,同时放松严格的脚本稳定性中止大门。 精确格式的提示(如:逐字记录复制,代码生成任务,直接翻译,严格的JSON/引用输出指令)被格式卫士自动检测并绕过. 在受控的飞行员中,保守相配比同语言的随机人物(Appendix C.)提升了20多分的样式采纳.

blocks.en: Conservative (Language-Matched) Selection: A persona is eligible only if it is verified to communicate natively in the prompt’s language and script. Non-Latin prompts are mapped strictly to native-speaking personas sharing the target script, non-English Latin prompts to detected-language personas, and English prompts to the broader English-speaking pool. A single best-matching persona is retrieved through prioritized tiers: geographic location matching, top-1 semantic embedding cosine similarity, or deterministic language-pool fallback. If no compatible persona exists, the pipeline returns the original turn verbatim.
blocks.zh: 保守( 语言- Matched) 选择 : 一个人a 只有在被证实以当事者的语言和脚本进行本土交流时才有资格。 非拉丁语的提示被严格地映射到讲本地语的人共享目标脚本,非英语拉丁语的提示被检测到语言的人,英语的提示被映射到更广泛的英语池. 通过优先等级检索出单一的最佳匹配人a:地理位置相匹配、上一语义嵌入同位素相似性,或确定性语言库倒置。 如果不存在相容的人物a,则管道返回原转盘逐字记录.

blocks.en: Cross-Lingual Diverse Selection: To reflect authentic multilingual populations who interact with LLMs in global languages, this mode samples a single persona uniformly at random from the entire bank (where native-English personas constitute only 19.6%), allowing non-English personas to re-voice prompts with their regional register, cultural framing, and loanwords while relaxing strict script-stability abort gates.
blocks.zh: 跨语言 不同选择 : 为了反映以全球语言与LLMS互动的真实的多语言人群,这个模式从整个银行中随机抽取一个单一的人a(当地人-英语人仅占19.6%),允许非英语人用他们的区域注册、文化框架和出借词重新发出提示,同时放松严格的脚本稳定性中止大门。

blocks.en: For eligible turns, the rewriter is instructed to preserve the original intent while introducing only subtle persona traits. Linguistic quirks and colloquialisms are applied probabilistically at a rate of p = 0.25 p=0.25 per turn. This probability alone has no consistent effect on over-stylization; the effective lever is an explicit cap of at most two realized chat markers per turn (greeting, sign-off, emoji, slang, ellipsis, repeated punctuation), given as an instruction in the rewrite prompt, which we recommend as the default setting (Appendix D ). A length-ratio guard automatically rejects over-compressed rewrites ( < 50 % <50\% of the original length), falling back to the verbatim seed prompt if any validation gate fails. Quoted text, code, URLs and numbers are masked before the rewrite and restored afterwards, and a rewrite that loses a masked span is retried. In cross-lingual mode, we tried two ways of reaching the persona’s language: re-voicing the source turn directly into that language in a single pass, and first translating each turn literally and then restyling the translation with the same-language rewrite. The two-step variant preserves the request and lands in the target language more reliably, at a small cost in style adoption (Appendix C ), so the pipeline uses it.
blocks.zh: 对于符合条件的转会,重写者被指示保留原意而仅引入微妙人物的特质. 语言夸克和口语学的应用概率为p=0.25p=0.25每转. 仅此概率对过平板化没有一致的影响;有效的杠杆是每个转弯最多两个已实现的聊天标记(greeting, sign-off, emoji, slang, ellipsis, 重复的 punctuation)的明确上限,作为重写快取的指令,我们建议作为默认设置(Appendix D.). 一个长度- ratio 守护自动拒绝过度压缩的重写( < 50% < 50 > > > 原长度), 如果任何验证门失败, 则返回逐字记录种子提示 。 被引用的文字,代码,URL和数字在重写前被遮住并随后被还原,一个丢失了被遮住的跨度的重写被重审. 在跨语言模式下,我们尝试了两种方式来达到人的语言:用一通路口重新表达源头直接转换成该语言,然后先逐字翻译出每个转折,再用同一种语言重写来恢复翻译. 双步变体更可靠地保留了请求并用目标语言登陆,在风格采纳(Appendix C.)中成本很小,因此管道使用.

blocks.en: The restyled user turn is appended to the running context, and the assistant response is regenerated. The persona background/style is provided to the responder as an unsaved system prompt: the model sees the user’s register during generation, but the stored training example contains only the observable user and assistant turns, so a downstream learner acquires style from conversational cues, not from hidden persona metadata. For non-final turns, a judge checks whether the regenerated response plausibly leads to the actual next user message from the log; if not, a bounded adaptation loop (up to 2 iterations) rewrites the assistant response so that the real historical follow-up remains a coherent continuation, preserving the logged dialogue trajectory. If the judge still flags the response after the last iteration, the last adapted response is kept and left to the sanity gate. The continuity-judge and adaptation prompts are given in Appendix B.1 .
blocks.zh: 复用用户转接被附加在运行上下文,助手响应被再生成. 人物背景/风格作为未保存的系统提示提供给响应者:模型在生成时看到用户的注册,但被存储的训练实例中只包含可观察到的用户和助手转动,因此下游学习者从对话提示而不是从隐藏的人物元数据中获得风格. 对于非最终回合,法官检查重生成的响应是否合理导致日志中实际的下个用户消息;如果没有,一个有界限的适应回路(最多2个迭代)会重写助手的响应,这样真实的历史后续仍是一个连贯的延续,保留了被记录的对话轨迹. 如果法官在最后一次重复后仍会标出响应,则最后调整后的反应会被保留下来并被留在智取门上. 连续性判断和适应提示见附录B.1。

blocks.en: A final judge screens each conversation for six failure classes: language mismatch (for conservative matching), instruction/format violation, truncation, fabricated personal experience, incoherence/hallucination, and failure to address the request. These sanity verdicts are stored as metadata flags, allowing downstream training pipelines to selectively filter for strictly validated, constraint-intact dialogues.
blocks.zh: 最终法官为六门失败课筛选出每门对话:语言不匹配(用于保守配对),指令/格式违规,截取,编造个人经历,前后不一/口服,以及未能回应请求. 这些理智判断被存储为元数据旗,允许下游培训管道有选择地过滤,用于严格验证,约束-插入的对话.

blocks.en: 5 Evaluation and Augmentation Analysis
blocks.zh: 5. 评价和增强分析

blocks.en:
We target two main tasks with our proposed persona-based augmentation method: it should sound like the seeded user (style adoption) and still keep the same original topic in the same language (intent preservation).
To do this, we define two fidelity axes and evaluate them on the released corpus (Section 6 ), using both an out-of-family LLM judge and deterministic, judge-free metrics; we then conduct a paired, order-randomized A/B to isolate the effect of style representation by holding generator model, persona, and token budget fixed; and finally, we re-score a stratified subset with four judges to confirm the direction is not a single-judge artifact.
blocks.zh:
我们的目标是两项主要任务,采用我们提议的基于人物的增强方法:它应该听起来像被种子的使用者(式收养),并且仍然用同一种语言(意向性保存)保留相同的原始主题.
为此,我们界定了两个忠诚轴并评估了释放的委托书(第6节),既使用了家庭外的LLM法官,又使用了确定性的、无法官的衡量标准;然后我们进行了对等的、随意的A/B,通过持有生成模型、人物和象征性预算来隔离风格代表的效果;最后,我们重新确定了一个分级子集,由四名法官组成,以确认方向不是单一法官的文物。

blocks.en: We evaluate both fidelity axes through two complementary measures: an out-of-family reasoning judge ( MiniMax-M2.5 ) and deterministic, judge-free heuristics (Appendix C ). Over the whole corpus, the LLM judge yields 96.6% intent preservation and 67.1% style adoption (64.9% passing both simultaneously), with higher-capacity generator backbones adopting style more faithfully ( Gemma-4-31B : 69.8% vs. Ministral-3-14B : 63.2%). Because this check is lenient toward added details, we additionally give every user turn a strict four-way label (same request, added content, dropped content, scope change): about three in four turns keep the exact request and nearly all keep the core request, and both a second external judge and a blind human check agree with the label (Appendix C ). The deterministic metrics show that rewrites introduce substantial surface variation while preserving meaning: same-language rewrites change a large share of the surface form yet retain most core vocabulary, and multilingual embedding similarity remains high for both same-language and cross-lingual rewrites (Table 9 ). Computed on the same seeds without a persona and with the PersonaHub and SynthPAI forms, these metrics show that each step up in style information moves the text further from the seed and raises style adherence, with our format changing the text most and adhering best (Appendix C ). Style adherence varies by attribute: emoji usage is followed almost always, punctuation and capitalization patterns only moderately, and message length grows for personas who write long messages but barely shrinks for those who write short ones.
blocks.zh: 我们通过两个补充措施评估忠贞轴:一名家庭外推理法官(MiniMax-M2.5)和确定性、无法官的heuristics(附录C)。 在整体上,LLM法官的意向保留率为96.6%,采用风格的比例为67.1%(64.9%同时通过两者),高容量发电机主干采用风格更加忠实(Gemma-4-31B:69.8%对Ministryal-3-14B:63.2%)。 由于这项检查对新增细节很宽容,我们额外给每个用户一个严格的四向标签(相同的请求,添加的内容,删除的内容,范围更改):大约四分之三的回转都保留了确切的请求,几乎全部保留了核心请求,第二个外部法官和一个盲目的人类检查都同意标签(附录C). 决定性的度量法显示,重写在保留意义的同时引入了实质性的表面差异:同语重写会改变一大部分表面形态,但保留了大部分核心词汇,多语种嵌入类似性对于同语和跨语种重写仍然很高(表9). 这些度量法计算在同一个没有人物的种子上,并以PersonaHub和SynthPAI的形式,显示在样式信息中,每一步一步地将文本从种子中更远地移动出,并提升了样式的坚持性,我们的格式对文本的修改最多,遵守性最好(附录C. 风格的坚持程度因属性而异:emoji的用法几乎总是遵循,平分和资本化模式只有中度,对于写出长信息而写出短信息的人来说,消息长度却几乎没有收缩.

blocks.en: Our central design question concerns representation: to make a user sound a certain way, is it better to provide the rewriter with a single free-text style description of 1–2 short sentences (flat) or with the per-axis structured style keys (structured)? We compared the two in a paired A/B on a sample of 553 real user messages (518 after the pipeline’s judge passing stage), using the same rewriter and selected persona. An independent judge ( MiniMax-M2.5 ) issues a pairwise style-fidelity verdict with A/B order randomized per item, alongside a separate intent check for each rewrite.
blocks.zh: 我们的中心设计问题涉及表现:要使用户的声音有某种方式,向重写者提供1–2个自由文字风格描述(平面)还是每轴结构风格键(结构化)更好? 我们用同样的重写和选定的人物a对553个真实用户信息(管道法官过后518个)进行对比。 独立法官(MiniMax-M2.5)发布双向风格-诚实判断,每件A/B命令随机化,同时对每件重写单独进行意向检查.

blocks.en: Table 1: Structured vs. flat style representation (%, except length in characters). Top: for each pair, the judge picks the rewrite that better matches the persona’s style. Bottom: intent preservation and length, measured separately for each rewrite. The judge returned a parseable verdict for 433 pairs; 95% Wilson intervals: structured preferred 55.4–64.6, flat preferred 28.8–37.6.
blocks.zh: 表1:结构化与平面风格代表(百分比,除字符长度外). 顶部:对于每一对,法官会选择更符合人物风格的重写. 底部:意向保全和长度,为每次重写分别测量. 法官退回了433对可解析的判决;95%的威尔逊间隔:结构偏好55.4-64.6,平面偏好28.8-37.6.

blocks.en: Table 1 reports how often each rewrite was preferred. The structured representation is preferred in 60% of pairs against 33% for the flat one (the rest are ties), nearly twice as often, while intent preservation and rewrite length are the same. The judge’s comments credit the structured rewrites for keeping markers that the flat rewrites smooth away, such as signature abbreviations, sign-offs, ellipsis pauses and code-switched tokens. We read this as explicit, separable levers being easier for a rewriter to follow faithfully than one prose sentence it must parse and prioritize (Figure 2 ). Because intent and length are held fixed, the gain comes from the representation and not from the rewriter working harder. Ablating one persona attribute at a time shows that single attributes have similar, small effects, while together they visibly shape the rewrite (Appendix F ).

blocks.en: We also compare PersonaFactory to the profile formats of PersonaHub ( Ge et al., 2025 ) and SynthPAI ( Yukhymenko et al., 2024 ) , keeping all the settings but the profile representation. Table 2 shows a clear pattern: formats that describe writing behavior more explicitly produce stronger style adoption, and PersonaFactory is preferred in every pairwise comparison. PersonaHub, which has no writing-style field, performs only slightly above the no-persona baseline. The ranking holds when the judges see only format-neutral style attributes, under two external judges, and against real PersonaHub personas, while real SynthPAI profiles are on par. Richer style conditioning has a moderate cost: intent preservation drops by about four points, almost entirely on cross-lingual prompts, and external judges rate the rewrites somewhat less natural; capping the number of chat markers realized per turn closes this naturalness gap while keeping most of the style advantage (Appendix D ). Since the SynthPAI form carries less style information, this comparison mixes structure with content: at matched content and length, the structured form is on par in style but keeps the request more often and reads more naturally (Appendix D ). Appendix D provides the full breakdown and robustness checks.
blocks.zh: 我们还将PersonaFactory与PersonaHub(Ge等人,2025年)和SynthPAI(Yukhymenko等人,2024年)的配置格式进行比较,保留除配置代表以外的所有设置. 表2显示了一个清晰的图案:描述写作行为更明确的格式产生更强烈的风格采纳,在每次对等比较中PersonaFactory都是首选. PersonaHub没有写作风格的字段,其性能仅略高于无人基线. 排名在评委只看到格式中性风格属性,在两个外聘评委之下,与真实的PersonaHub personas相对立,而真实的SynthPAI配置则处于平面. 更丰富的风格调制成本适中:意向保存下降约4分,几乎完全在跨语言的提示上,外部评委对重写的评价略低于自然;将每个转弯实现的聊天标记数量封顶,同时保持了大部分风格优势(Appendix D. 由于SynthPAI形式携带的样式信息较少,因此这种比较将结构与内容相混合:在匹配的内容和长度上,结构化的形式在样式上是等同的,但更经常地保留请求并更自然地阅读(Appendix D.). 附 录 D提供了完整的分解和坚固性检查。

blocks.en: The style layer can also extend existing persona banks: when PersonaHub and Nemotron-Personas samples are converted to our background representation and given a generated style layer, all three judges prefer the resulting rewrites over the real WildChat messages (e.g. 67.6% against 17.6% for MiniMax-M2.5 , Appendix D ). This preference mainly reflects more casual typing than real users show (greetings, slang and emoji appear several times more often), rather than closer realism, and the marker cap addresses it.

blocks.en: LLM-based judge scoring is prone to bias and stereotypical evaluation; models may also provide lower-quality evaluation if they display generic user alignment themselves. We therefore test the judge choice in two ways. First, we re-score a sampled subset of persona rewrites with four judges ( Gemma-4-31B , GLM-4.7-Flash , Ministral-3-14B , MiniMax-M2.5 ). The judges differ in severity, so raw agreement overstates consistency: chance-corrected agreement ranges from moderate to strong for most pairs, and every pair involving the production judge reaches Cohen’s κ \kappa of at least 0.32 on style and 0.22 on intent, but it is near chance for one pair of lenient judges on style (Appendix C ). Second, because these four models are also generators or the production judge of the pipeline, we re-score the central A/B of Table 1 with three judges from outside the pipeline ( DeepSeek-V4-Flash , Qwen3.5-397B-A17B , Qwen3.6-35B-A3B ). All three prefer the structured representation, with decisive-verdict shares between 54% and 71% (Table 13 ). We use MiniMax-M2.5 as the production judge because it is not one of the production rewriters and is the strictest on style among the candidates (Table 10 ), giving the pipeline a more conservative evaluation during generation.
blocks.zh: 基于LLM的法官评分容易出现偏见和陈规定型评价;如果模型本身显示通用用户对齐,它们也可能提供质量较低的评价. 因此,我们以两种方式检验法官的选择。 首先,我们重新对一组人进行抽样的重写,有四个评委(Gemma-4-31B、GLM-4.7-Flash、Ministal-3-14B、MiniMax-M2.5)。 法官们在严重程度上有所不同,因此原始协议夸大了一致性:对大多数对子来说,机会修正的协议从中到强不等,每对涉及制作法官的协议都达到科恩在风格上至少0.32分和意向上0.22分,但对于一对在风格上较为宽松的法官来说(附录C ) 几乎是偶然的。 第二,由于这四个型号也是输油管的发电机或生产裁判员,我们用输油管外出的三个裁判员(DeepSeek-V4-Flash., Quen3.5-397B-A17B., Quen3.6-35B-A3B.)来重新计分表1的A/B中心. 这三个国家都倾向于结构化代表,决定性的确定份额在54%至71%之间(表13)。 我们使用MiniMax-M2.5作为制作评委,因为它不是制作重写者之一,也是候选人中风格最严格的(表10),使得管道在一代人的时间里得到了更保守的评价.

blocks.en: To validate the effectiveness of the user augmentation pipeline, we run an IRB-approved preliminary expert study in which AI experts rate corpus samples in their native/fluent languages on four tasks: 1) intent preservation after the rewrite step; 2) style following in augmented user prompts in a natural way; 3) human- vs AI-written text classification (our chats mixed with WildChat samples, written by humans); 4) multilingual authenticity of updated conversations. So far, we have collected 11 responses across 9 languages, mostly with one rater per language, so we treat the study as a preliminary signal (Appendix E ; per-language results and the scope relative to related work in Appendices E.5 and E.6 ). Raters are favorable on intent, style and plausibility (median 4 of 5) (Table 18 ), and the blind test is the more telling result. Raters take verified model rewrites for human-written 59% of the time (Table 20 ) and separate them from real chat messages only slightly better than chance (55% accuracy, with a wide interval given the sample size). LLM judges are more easily fooled than people: they call 83–89% of the rewrites human-written, and are no better than chance at separating them from real messages. A trained classifier, in contrast, does separate our rewrites from the real turns they came from, in line with the computational Turing test of Pagan et al. (2026) , who find that LLM-generated text stays distinguishable from human communication and that pushing it toward human-likeness costs semantic fidelity; by keeping the original request, our pipeline sits on the fidelity side of this trade-off. On synthetic seeds, rewriting still moves typing substantially toward real users and raises style diversity, while on real logs it narrows diversity somewhat, so there its value lies in multilingual extension (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 为了验证用户增强管道的有效性,我们开展了由IRB核准的初步专家研究,其中AI专家用其母语/流利语言对样本进行四项任务评分: 1) 重写步骤之后的意向保留;2) 自然地遵循扩展用户提示的风格;3) 人-与AI-写作的文字分类(我们与WildChat样本相混合的聊天,由人类所写;4) 更新的对话的多语种真实性. 迄今为止,我们共收集了9种语言的11个答复,大多数是每种语言一个评分,因此我们把研究当作一个初步信号(附录E;每个语言的结果以及附录E.5和E.6中相关工作的范围)。 Raters对意图,风格和可信度(中间为5分之4)(表18)有偏好,盲目测试是更能说明问题的结果. Raters为人写作的59%的时间(表20)取出经过核实的模型重写,并且与真实的聊天信息相隔的时间仅略好于偶然(准确度为55%,由于样本大小,间隔很宽). LLM评委比人们更容易被愚弄:他们称83%-89%的重写为人文作文,而且没有比将他们与真实信息分开的机会更好的了. 一个训练有素的分类员, 将我们的重写和它们的真正转折区分开来, 符合Pagan等人(2026年)的计算图灵测试, 他们发现LLM生成的文本与人类的交流保持了区别, 在合成种子上,重写仍然会大幅度地向真实的用户打字并提升风格多样性,而在真实的日志上则会缩小一些多样性,因此其价值在于多语种扩展(Appendix C.).

blocks.en: 6 The PersonaFactory Conversational Dataset
blocks.zh: 6 人物事实对话数据集

blocks.en: Applying the pipeline at scale to three widely used conversational datasets, UltraChat ( Ding et al., 2023 ; Tunstall et al., 2023 ) , Nemotron Instruction-Following ( NVIDIA, 2025a ; Nathawani et al., 2025 ; NVIDIA, 2025b ) and WildChat ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) , yields 1,237,976 augmented conversations after deduplication, language verification and judge filtering (1,606,837 before the final sanity gate), covering 85 languages, as summarized in Table 3 . The released conversations contain 2,387,392 user turns, 1.93 per conversation on average. Real WildChat user turns make up more than half of the seeds, which broadens the corpus well beyond English (Appendix G.1 ). The corpus comprises both English-centered user conversations and multilingual ones, in which the persona’s native language is enforced in place of English. All 85 languages occur in the cross-lingual set; English makes up 38.2% of the full corpus but only 0.8% of the cross-lingual set. 3 3 3 We count the detected language of the first user turn (fastText language identification with a Lingua fallback), not the persona’s declared language, and merge variants the detector cannot separate (e.g. Malay and Indonesian, Bokmål and Norwegian). In the language-matched set, persona matching is predominantly driven by the semantic-embedding component, whereas the initial location matching and the language-pool fallback contribute less frequently.
blocks.zh: 将管道应用到三个广泛使用的对话数据集,Ultra Chat(Ding等,2023年;Tunstall等,2023年),Nemotron指令跟踪(NVIDIA,2025a;Nathawani等,2025年;NVIDIA,2025b)和Wild Chat(Zhao等,2024年),在分解后产生1,237,976次扩分对话,语言验证和法官过滤(1,606,837起在最后智障门前),涵盖85种语言,见表3。 发布的对话包含2,387,392个用户回合,平均每次对话1.93个. 真实的狂野 查特用户转会占了种子的一半以上,这远远超出了英语(Appendix G.1. 主体包括以英语为中心的用户对话以及多语种对话,在这些对话中,用人种的母语代替英语。 所有85种语言都出现在跨语系中;英语占全语系的38.2%,但仅占跨语系的0.8%。 3,3,我们计算第一个用户转弯时检测出的语言(快速Text语言识别与Lingua倒背),而不是人物所声明的语言,合并后检测器不能分离的变体(如马来语和印尼语, Bokmål和挪威语). 在与语言相匹配的集中,人称匹配主要由语义-嵌入组件所驱动,而初始位置匹配和语言集合回落则贡献较少.

blocks.en: In the multilingual split, generating conversations at the language-level yields better script stability across turns. The largest non-English languages are Chinese, Spanish, Russian, and French (per-language distributions are provided in Appendix G.1 , and intent and style per language and rewriter in Appendix C ). At the sub-regional level, the conversations use 13,714 distinct free-text dialect labels (e.g. cantonal Swiss German varieties; Appendix G.1 ); we treat these as a free-text label variety rather than a validated dialect taxonomy.
blocks.zh: 在多语种分裂中,在语言一级产生对话,使各轮文字更加稳定。 最大的非英语语言是中文、西班牙文、俄文和法文(附录G.1提供了每种语言的分布,附录C提供了每种语言的意向和风格并重写)。 在分区域一级,对话使用13 714个不同的自由文字方言标签(例如,瑞士州德文品种;附录G.1);我们将这些标签作为自由文字标签品种,而不是经过验证的方言分类法。

blocks.en: We observe that Gemma-augmented conversations pass the sanity gate far more often than Ministral ones (Table 3 ), as Ministral is more prone to making radical changes to the intent and style of the prompts. Pass rates are counted by the responder that generated the conversation; Ministral answers in high-resource cross-lingual conversations were later regenerated with Gemma and are released under Gemma. Nemotron samples are longer on average and often contain multi-step instructions or constraints, which lowers user-side style adoption (Appendix C ), while the final sanity pass rate is similar across seed sources, between 77% and 82% (Appendix G.1 ). In controlled probes Ministral restyles more aggressively than Gemma, but at the cost of intent (Appendix F ); at corpus scale, where rewrites must also survive the sanity gate, Gemma’s turns score higher on both style and intent (Appendix C ). We keep both models in the generator pool for greater diversity; the strict label makes the rewriter’s effect visible per turn (Appendix C ).
blocks.zh: 我们注意到,Gemma-aguated的谈话比Ministry的谈话更频繁地通过理智之门(表3),因为Ministry更倾向于对提示的用意和风格作根本性的改变. 传递率由生成对话的响应者计算;高资源跨语言对话中的Ministry answers后来被与Gemma重生,并在Gemma下放出. Nemotron样本的平均时间较长,经常包含多步指令或制约,这降低了用户-侧式的采纳(Appendix C ),而最终的疗效通过率在种子源之间相似,介于77%到82%之间(Appendix G.1 . 在受控探测器中,Ministry重塑出比Gemma更激烈的风格,但以意图为代价(Appendix F;以体积为代价,重写也必须从智取门中存活下来),Gemma在风格和意图上都得分较高(Appendix C. 我们保留两个模型在生成器池中,以便实现更大的多样性;严格的标签使得重写器的效果每转一转(Appendix C.

blocks.en: User-side personalization alone leaves the assistant with one standardized response style, with long, heavily formatted answers regardless of who is asking. As a pilot, we define 12 model personas with different response styles (e.g. answer-first compact prose, headed sections with numbered steps, or a gentle register for stressful topics), each with a free-text description, eight presentation axes (register, structure, density, warmth, explanation, jargon, certainty, emoji), optional signature touches ( p = 0.25 p=0.25 per reply, as for user quirks) and content safeguards; explicit user instructions override the style. A matcher ( MiniMax-M2.5 ) picks a model persona for each user persona, and the assistant turns are regenerated with both. This applies to part of the release (234,723 conversations carry a model persona); in the assistant-side ablation of Appendix G.2 this setup scores best among the conditioning variants, and the styles can also be applied without a user persona. We treat model personas as a controllable source of assistant-style diversity and a starting point for future work rather than a core component of the pipeline.
blocks.zh: 仅用户端个性化就给助手留下了一种标准化的响应风格,无论是谁在问,答案都长而繁多. 作为试点,我们定义了12个具有不同反应风格的模型人物(例如:回答-第一紧凑取词,标题部分有编号步骤,或对有压力的主题进行温和的收录),每个单元都有自由文字描述,8个演示轴(登记,结构,密度,温暖,解释,词典,确定性,emoji),可选的签名触点(p=0.25 p=0.25每回,对于用户的 qui克)和内容保障;明确的用户指令会超越风格. 一个匹配器(MiniMax-M2.5)为每个用户人选择一个模型人物a,助手转会与两者一起再生. 这适用于部分发行(234,723个会话搭载了型号人物a);在附录G.2的助手-侧缩写中,这种设置分数在调制变体中最好,风格也可以在没有用户人物a的情况下应用. 我们把模范人视为可控的助理式多样性来源和今后工作的起点,而不是管道的核心组成部分。

blocks.en: To measure what the data does for a model, we fine-tune Apertus-v1.5-8B base ( Project Apertus et al., 2026 ) on four versions of the same language-matched conversations: the original conversations, the original user turns with a regenerated assistant, restyled user turns with the original assistant, and our release (Appendix G.3 ). Models trained on our data are on par with those trained on the original conversations on capability benchmarks except GSM8K, are preferred on held-out real user prompts at equal reply length, and adapt their reply style to the user more. Regenerating the assistant for the restyled user is essential, as restyling the user side alone lowers instruction following, and training only on the strict subset changes none of these results. On cross-lingual conversations, our data gives the largest gain on multilingual instruction following.
blocks.zh: 为了衡量数据对于一个模型的作用,我们对Apertus-v1.5-8B基础(Project Apertus et al., 2026)在四个版本的同语言相匹配的对话上进行了微调:原始对话,原始用户与再生成的助理相交,重排用户与原始助理相交,以及我们的发布(Appendix G.3. 接受过数据培训的模型与接受过能力基准原始对话培训的模型相同,但GSM8K除外,在相同的答复长度下,更倾向于被搁置的真正用户提示,并更适应用户的回复风格。 重新为备用用户生成助手至关重要,因为仅重新配置用户一方会降低随后的指令,而只进行严格子集培训不会改变这些结果。 在跨文化对话方面,我们的数据对随后的多语教学有了最大的收益。

blocks.en: 7 Impact and Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 影响和限制

blocks.en: We hope our pipeline will stimulate a discussion on the effective use of synthetic personas in open-source data generation and LLM training. We release the persona bank and all generated conversations under a permissive license to further facilitate this effort; a key contribution is a culturally diverse dataset that we expect to be valuable for multilingual LLM development. The persona bank is fully synthetic. The conversations restyle openly released chat logs; for WildChat-seeded conversations, details already present in a seed can carry over into the rewrite, so this part inherits WildChat’s own anonymization (Appendix G.1 ). The pipeline relies on permissive open-weight models, providing reproducible and responsible resources for LLM training. At the same time, personas are conditioning variables, not real people or groups: they make no claim about how members of any nationality, region, gender, or profession actually communicate, and must not be used for profiling, targeting, or deceptive content presented as the first-person voice of a real individual.
blocks.zh: 我们希望,我们的管道将促进讨论在开源数据生成和LLM培训中有效利用合成人的问题。 我们释放了个人银行和所有通过许可进行的谈话,以进一步促进这一努力;一个关键的贡献是文化多样化的数据集,我们期望该数据集对多种语言的LLM发展很有价值。 人格银行是完全合成的。 对话重新格式化了公开发布的聊天日志;对于WildChat种子的对话,种子中已经出现的细节可以结转到重写中,因此这部分继承了WildChat自己的匿名(Appendix G.1 ). 管道依靠可允许的开放量级模型,为LLM培训提供可复制和负责任的资源。 同时,人是条件变量,而不是真实的人或群体:他们不对任何国籍、地区、性别或专业的成员如何实际沟通提出任何主张,不得用于描述、瞄准或欺骗内容,作为真实个人的第一人称声音。

blocks.en: Our work has several limitations, which we plan to address in future work. First, our IRB-approved human study is preliminary: it covers nine languages across three scripts, mostly with a single volunteer expert rater per language, so per-language results are indicative only (Appendix E ). Human studies of synthetic personas with larger rater pools have so far been English-only, and multilingual persona datasets report no human evaluation or cover a single region (Appendix E.6 ); extending ours to several paid native raters per language is left to future work. Generation quality is also weaker in some languages, as the Greek panel shows. Second, the downstream study supports the complete pipeline rather than user-side restyling alone (Appendix G.3 ). Third, coverage remains imbalanced: a few major languages dominate the multilingual tail, and low digital fluency and code-switching remain minority traits. Fourth, the corpus realizes some chat markers, emoji in particular, more often than real users do, because it was generated without the explicit marker cap that we recommend (Appendix D ); pattern correspondence with real users holds by language rather than by country (Appendix C ); and dialect labels are not validated in text. Finally, the 12 hand-written model personas are a first step: the matcher favors a few of them, and the size of the persona set and on-policy persona sampling are open directions. When a source conversation carries its own system prompt, the style competes with its format and length constraints, so we leave such conversations without a model persona (Appendix G.2 ).
blocks.zh: 我们的工作有一些局限性,我们计划在今后的工作中加以解决。 首先,我们IRB批准的人类研究是初步的:它涵盖三种文字的9种语言,大多数每种语言都有一位志愿专家评分,因此每个语言的结果只是指示性的(附录E. 人类对人工合成人的研究迄今只使用英语,多语种人文数据集报告没有进行人类评价,也没有覆盖一个地区(附录E.6);将我们的研究扩大到每个语言的几个付费本土人,则留给未来工作。 生成质量在一些语言中也较弱,如希腊面板所示. 第二,下游研究支持完整的管道,而不是仅依靠用户端的休息(附录G.3. 第三,覆盖面仍然不平衡:少数主要语言在多语种尾巴中占主导地位,数字流畅度低和代码切换率低仍然是少数特征. 第四,本体意识到一些聊天标记,尤其是emoji,比真实的用户更频繁,因为它是在没有我们推荐的明确标记封顶(Appendix D)的情况下产生的;与真实用户的图案通信是按语言而不是按国家持有的(Appendix C);而方言标签在文本中没有验证. 最后,12个手写模型人物是第一步:配对者喜欢其中的几个,人物集的大小和政策人物的取样是开放方向. 当一个源对话携带着自己的系统即时,风格会与其格式和长度限制相竞争,因此我们离开这样的对话时没有模型人物a(Appendix G.2 .

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we present PersonaFactory, a pipeline that restyles the user side of existing conversations with synthetic personas while preserving the original intent. Our key contributions are a bank of 743,010 structured synthetic personas; a corpus of roughly 1.24 million personalized conversations in 85 languages, produced by a language-aware pipeline that re-simulates the user side of existing conversations while preserving intent and trajectory, with a strict intent label on every user turn; and an evaluation of the impact of persona features on intent and style. We find that separating persona background from writing style gives per-axis control with better intent preservation and moves synthetic seeds toward real-user typing, while a marker cap keeps the style natural. We believe this work lays a foundation for further research into the influence of persona detail on the conversational alignment of LLMs.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们介绍了PersonaFactory,这个管道在保留原意的同时,重新塑造了与合成人的现有对话的用户面. 我们的主要贡献是:743 010个结构化合成人银行;用85个语言制作的大约124万个个个性化对话体,由语言意识的管道制作,该管道在保留意图和轨迹的同时,重新模拟现有对话的用户方面,在每个用户回合上贴上严格的意向标签;评价人的特点对意图和风格的影响。 我们发现,将个人背景与写作风格区分开来,可以更好地控制每个轴的意向,并将合成种子转移到真实用户的打字上,而标记盖则保持了风格自然. 我们认为,这项工作为进一步研究个人细节对法学硕士课程对话配合的影响奠定了基础。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en:
The persona bank is fully synthetic, and the augmented conversations are based on the openly released chat datasets UltraChat ( Ding et al., 2023 ) , Nemotron Instruction-Following ( NVIDIA, 2025a ) and WildChat ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) , which we credit and use under their original terms. WildChat consists of real user logs whose personally identifiable information (names, phone numbers, email addresses, card numbers, URLs) was removed by its authors with Microsoft Presidio ( Microsoft, 2024 ) and hand-written rules before release ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) . We additionally ran Presidio over WildChat-seeded rewrites: they do not add contact details, but details that remain in a WildChat seed can carry over, so this part of the release inherits WildChat’s anonymization (Appendix G.1 ). No persona in the bank is
derived from, or matched to, an identifiable individual. Personas are conditioning variables rather than descriptions of real groups: they make no claim about how members of any nationality, region, gender, or profession actually write, and we decouple occupation from region precisely to suppress the stereotypical
associations we observed when the two were sampled jointly (Section 3 ). Every profile passes an independent judge that scores
stereotype severity, and the residual risk of the release is the obvious one: a persona bank that encodes how people type can also be used to mass-produce stereotyped text, or to present synthetic output as the first-person voice of a real person. We release under a permissive license with these uses explicitly disallowed, and we discuss impact and residual limitations in Section 7 . All generator and judge models used here are open-weight models with permissive usage terms. The human evaluation was approved by the ethics review board (IRB) of the authors’ institution and classified as minimal risk; participants were volunteer domain experts who gave informed consent, took part unpaid in their professional capacity, could skip items or withdraw at any time, and were identified only by random participant IDs, with no names, contact details, or IP addresses collected (Appendix E ).

blocks.en: Reproducibility Statement
blocks.zh: 可复制声明

blocks.en: To ensure reproducibility of our work, we are releasing the pipeline codebase and the produced persona bank together with a dataset of augmented conversations. We describe in full detail the process of synthetic persona creation (including persona schema, the curated country/sub-region and occupation grid, the models used for judging and generation) in Section 3 and Appendix A ; further pipeline stages are described in Section 4 , which provides information to reproduce the conversation augmentation using our proposed personas with details on the models used, generation settings (all sampling parameters in Appendix B.2 ), persona feature representation and feature-level sampling conditions. We also provide the prompts used to generate these parts (profile generation, user-turn adaptation, and the persona-conditioned responder prompt) verbatim in Appendix B.1 together with end-to-end examples of chat augmentation based on a provided persona in Appendix B.3 . Ablation experiments and motivation behind selection of the final setup choices like judge models, style representation during augmentation and others are presented in Section 5 , Appendix F and Appendix D . Corpus composition, matching-tier counts, and sanity-gate pass rates are reported in Section 6 and Appendix G.1 . We publicly release the persona bank, the augmented conversational dataset, and the pipeline code under a permissive license.
blocks.zh: 为了确保我们工作的可复制性,我们正在释放输油管密码库和生产的人的银行,以及一套扩大的对话数据。 我们详细描述了第3节和附录A中的合成人创造过程(包括人造人计划、国家/分区域和占领网格、用于判断和生成的模型);第4节介绍了进一步的管道阶段,该节提供了信息,利用我们拟议的人来复制对话增强,详细介绍了所使用的模型、生成环境(附录B.2中的所有抽样参数)、人造人特征说明和特征一级的取样条件。 我们还在附录B.1中提供用于生成这些部分的提示(显式生成、用户转动调整和人称条件响应器即时),以及基于附录B.3中提供的人a的对端聊天增强实例。 第5节、附录F和附录D介绍了选择法官模型、扩编期间的风格表现等最后设置选择背后的考虑试验和动机。 第6节和附录G.1中报告了公司构成、对应等级计数和疗养门通过率。 我们公开发布个人的银行, 扩充的谈话数据集, 和管道代码 在许可。

blocks.en: AI Use Statement
blocks.zh: AI 使用语句

blocks.en: Generative models are the object of study and a core component of the method itself: persona profiles, user-turn rewrites, assistant regenerations, and every fidelity verdict are produced by the open-weight models named in Sections 3 and 4 and in Appendix C , with their prompts given verbatim in Appendix B.1 and their validation criteria stated alongside. We additionally used generative AI tools for writing assistance (copy-editing and phrasing) and for coding assistance in the analysis and visualization scripts. Research ideas, experimental design, and the interpretation of results are the authors’ own. All AI-assisted output was reviewed by the authors: generated code was inspected and tested, and every reported number was checked against the underlying run artifacts. We take responsibility for the final content of this work, including text, claims, and artifacts produced with the aid of generative AI.

blocks.en: Figures 3 – 5 break the same bank down by geography and by individual attribute. All percentages are over the 743,010 released profiles. The largest country shares are Indonesia (27,004 profiles), China (26,109) and India (25,947), with substantial mass throughout Southeast Asia, Europe and Sub-Saharan Africa (Figure 3 ). In the background layer (Figure 4 ), gender, AI stance and generator model are close to balanced by construction and macro-regions follow the per-country sampling quotas, while age, education and digital fluency inherit the skews discussed in Section 7 : the bank is younger, more highly educated and more digitally fluent than a representative population, and occupations concentrate on students and technology roles. In the style layer (Figure 5 ), non-standard registers are well represented: about two fifths of profiles drop end punctuation and almost a quarter type in all lowercase. Frequent decorative emoji use is deliberately limited to about 5% of profiles, since it otherwise dominates the rewritten turns.

blocks.en: Persona profile generation (bank) You are an expert sociologist and character designer. Generate ONE highly realistic persona as a single valid JSON object. Seed constraints (use EXACTLY these values, do not change them): - Macro Region: {region} - Country: {country} - Sub-region: {sub_region} - Profession: {occupation} (sector: {sector}) - Gender: {gender} - Age: {age} (use EXACTLY this age; make occupation seniority, education, and life-stage consistent with it) - AI Stance: {ai_stance} - Digital Fluency: {digital_fluency}[optional code-switching-off constraint] Fill every field in the JSON schema below so the whole persona is jointly coherent and culturally accurate. AGE COHERENCE (mandatory, applies to the WHOLE persona): every cultural, technological, and media reference ANYWHERE — reference_pool, linguistic_quirks, example_message, character_description — must belong to the world THIS person’s age cohort actually grew up in and uses NOW. Someone in their teens/20s/30s references contemporary, currently-live culture (the apps, platforms, creators, games, streamers, music, memes and slang of their own generation and today) — NOT obsolete technology (floppy disks, VHS, cassettes, dial-up, rotary phones, fax machines, typewriters, disk drives), NOT bygone decades or Cold-War / Soviet / "old-country" nostalgia, and NOT their parents’/grandparents’ world presented as their own. Only genuinely older personas (roughly 50+) carry firsthand older-era references, and only where it fits. Never reach for a dated or nostalgic reference as shorthand for a nationality — that is caricature, not realism. Every reference must also be internally coherent (no mislabelled objects, e.g. calling a smartphone "headphones"). BACKGROUND layer — demographic and cultural facts. Use the exact seeded values above. - The profession is FIXED as "{occupation}". Do NOT change it and do NOT swap it for whatever industry {country}/{sub_region} is stereotypically famous for. A person from a farming region can be a QA tester; a person from a coastal city can be an accountant. Location shapes their language, culture, and references — not their choice of job. - "job_title": make "{occupation}" concrete with a SHORT specific title — a sub-specialty and the type of employer (self-employed, small local business, large company, public sector, gig/freelance). Keep it to a brief phrase, **max ˜12 words** — NOT a sentence or a paragraph, and do NOT narrate day-to-day tasks here (that belongs in character_description). Detail must come from the WORK, not from regional cliché. **Do NOT name specific real brands, companies, apps, platforms, or vehicle makes/models** — describe them generically instead (e.g. "a ride-hailing app" not "Yandex.Go" or "Uber"; "an older compact sedan" not "2016 Hyundai Accent"; "a large e-commerce firm" not "Amazon"). Naming a real brand risks geographic/factual contradictions (e.g. a service that isn’t available in the persona’s country). Seniority MUST be consistent with age: do NOT use "Senior"/"Head"/"Lead"/"Chief" or "N years of experience" unless the age plausibly supports it — someone in their 20s is junior/early-career, not a senior overseeing a team. Examples: "Electrician" -> "self-employed electrician, solar-panel installs"; "Chartered accountant" -> "tax accountant at a mid-size firm, SME clients"; "Backend developer" -> "backend developer, payments API at a logistics firm"; "Rideshare driver" -> "part-time ride-hailing driver, family-owned compact car". - [optional sub-region language/dialect conditioning block] - LANGUAGE fields (keep a clean hierarchy — do NOT be verbose): "main_language" = the primary language as a STANDARD canonical name ONLY, with no parentheses, script notes, "variant"/"accent", or region qualifiers (e.g. "German", "French", "Mandarin Chinese", "Romansh", "English", "Ukrainian"). "native_language" is the same language and may append the specific variety only if it matters, but stays short. "dialect" = a CONCISE variant or region label, at most ˜4 words, with NO example words, phrases, or sentences (e.g. "Austrian", "Swiss", "Odesa surzhyk", "Galician", "Kansai-ben"), or "Standard" if there is no notable dialect. Never put a description or examples in the dialect field. STYLE layer — exactly how they write. - "chatting_style": ONE concrete sentence describing how THIS person types in an informal chat — capitalization, punctuation, abbreviations, sentence completeness. Ground it in their age, education, and digital fluency. No generic template, no flowery adjectives. (This is the original free-text description.) - "chatting_style_structured": the SAME behaviour broken into keys. For each key pick the option that fits (or write a short specific value): - capitalization: Standard | all lowercase | first-word-only, no final period | inconsistent | ALL-CAPS for emphasis - punctuation: standard | minimal (drops end punctuation) | ellipsis-heavy (...) | excessive (!!!/???) | emoji or line-breaks instead of punctuation - emoji_use: none | rare/functional | frequent/decorative | emoticons only ( :) ) | kaomoji/stickers - abbreviation_habits: the concrete abbreviations/shortcuts they actually use, or "None" - message_structure: terse one-liners | medium, complete sentences | long/elaborate | fragmented across several short lines - typo_tendency: clean/proofread | occasional uncorrected typos | phonetic spelling | voice-to-text/autocorrect artifacts - greeting_signoff: how they open/close a message, or "None" The structured keys MUST be consistent with the free-text "chatting_style" sentence. - "example_message": a realistic 1-2 sentence VERBATIM example of a casual message this exact persona would send to an AI chat assistant (a question or request they’d actually have). It must READ like something they’d really type — reflecting their chatting_style, quirks, native-language influence, and code-switching. Write the message itself, NOT a description of it, and do NOT make it sound like an AI assistant. - "chatbot_language_pref": how THIS person would address an AI chatbot. Non-native-English speakers with High/Medium digital fluency often use English for technical/professional tasks (efficiency, vocabulary) but their native language for everyday/personal ones; low-fluency or strongly local personas use their native language throughout. A short phrase, e.g. "English for coding, Ukrainian for everyday" or "always Arabic". - "reference_pool": 3-6 cultural touchstones this person actually draws on — media, tools, sayings, communities, shared references. EACH must be coherent (no mislabelled objects, e.g. do NOT call a smartphone "headphones") and must fit their AGE COHORT: a person in their teens/20s references the apps, creators, games, music and memes THEY grew up with (2010s-2020s), not their parents’/grandparents’ era. Only personas old enough (roughly 50+) carry firsthand older-era references, and only where it genuinely fits. Do NOT default to Soviet / Cold-War / "old country" nostalgia (or any bygone-era cliché) to signal a nationality — that is a lazy anachronistic stereotype; use living, contemporary, locally-current culture instead. - "linguistic_quirks": 2-4 specific, observable text habits. EACH must be individually earned by this person’s profession, personality, and culture. If a quirk would plausibly apply to most people of their region, gender, or education bracket, it is a stereotype — choose something more specific and personal. Aim for variety across personas. - "character_description": 3-5 sentences on who they are, their work, life context, and outlook. Background facts and personality only — do NOT describe how they type (that belongs in the style layer). Strict JSON schema: [full JSON schema of the Persona model] Output ONLY the JSON object, starting with { and ending with }. No markdown wrappers, no explanations.

CONSTITUTION — avoid these LLM artifacts in the rewrite: - No em-dashes (—). Real users almost never type these. - No assistant-speak openers like "Certainly!", "Of course!", "Absolutely!" — those are AI patterns, not user patterns. - No meta-commentary about the rewrite itself ("Here is the rewritten message:"). - Emojis: only if the persona’s typing style explicitly mentions them. - Apologetic or deferential language: only if it appears in the persona’s linguistic quirks. Do not add it on your own. Output ONLY the rewritten message. No quotes, no markdown, no preamble.

blocks.en: Persona-conditioned responder system prompt You are an AI assistant. The person you are talking to has the following background: {background} This is how they typically communicate: {writing_style} INVARIANTS — these hold no matter what the persona suggests: - You are an AI assistant, not the persona. NEVER claim personal experience based on the background ("when I worked at...", "I have a friend who...", "in my country we..."). Speak as an assistant. - Do not mention, reference, or describe the user’s background. Do not name their job, location, age, or family. - Maintain full technical and factual correctness. If the user asks for code, give complete working code. If they ask to repeat a phrase verbatim, repeat it verbatim. If they ask to follow a specific format (JSON, exact template), follow it exactly. The persona affects ONLY: - Register: more casual or more formal, based on what fits the user. - Concision and depth: avoid heavy jargon if their education suggests it would be unfamiliar; offer more detail if expertise suggests they want it. - Which examples or framings naturally resonate. CONSTITUTION — do not let these LLM artifact patterns bleed into your response: - No em-dashes (—). - No emojis, unless the user’s writing style explicitly includes them. - No opener fillers: "Certainly!", "Great question!", "Of course!", "Absolutely!", "Sure!". - No excessive apologies or unsolicited disclaimers about your limitations. - Do not reference or describe the user’s background in your response. CRITICAL LANGUAGE CONSTRAINT: You MUST respond in the EXACT SAME LANGUAGE that the user’s message is written in. Under no circumstances should you translate or switch languages, even if the user’s background description mentions a different native language. If the user’s message is in English, you must reply in English. If the user’s message is in Chinese, you must reply in Chinese.

blocks.en: B.2 Decoding Settings
blocks.zh: B.2 解码设置

blocks.en: Table 5 lists the sampling parameters of every model call in the pipeline and in the evaluation. All open-weight models are served with vLLM, except MiniMax-M2.5 , which is served with SGLang. Rewriters and responders run with thinking disabled; the reasoning judges think by default, and their reasoning is removed before the verdict is parsed. A corpus-judge verdict that cannot be parsed is requested once more with the larger budget, and the model persona matcher is asked at most three times.
blocks.zh: 表5列出了管道中和评价中每个模型调用的抽样参数。 所有开口量级的车型都使用vLLM服务,但MiniMax-M2.5除外,后者使用SGLang服务. 重写者和应答者以思维被禁运行;推理法官以默认方式思考,他们的推理在判决解析前被删除. 要求再用更大的预算对无法解析的案卷法官作出判决,最多要向模特人提出三次要求。

blocks.en: Table 5: Decoding settings. T T : temperature; max tokens: generation budget per call. A dash means the server default.
blocks.zh: 表5:解码设置. T T : 温度; 最大符号:每次呼叫生成预算。 一个破折叠表示服务器默认值.

blocks.en: The persona quirk probability is p = 0.25 p=0.25 per user turn, as for the model-persona signature touches. The continuity loop adapts a response at most twice, and a failed rewrite or translation is retried at most three times. Persona matching uses all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings with mean pooling and a cosine threshold of 0.15.
blocks.zh: 人称夸克概率为p=0.25p=0.25每名用户转弯,而模型-人称签名触碰则如此. 连续回路最多可调整一次响应两次,失败的重写或翻译最多可重复三次. Persona配对采用全-MiniLM-L6-v2嵌入式,中间集合并有0.15的余弦阈值.

blocks.en: B.3 Examples of Persona-Based Conversation Augmentation
blocks.zh: B.3 以人为本的对话增强实例

blocks.en: End-to-end examples from the released corpus, each showing how the pipeline matches a persona profile, re-voices the user turns while preserving topical constraints, and holds the register across turns. Together they cover the behaviors discussed in Sections 4 and 6 : dialect register (Figure 7 ), the verbatim guard on quoted material (Figure 8 ), code-switching (Figure 9 ), cross-lingual re-voicing with multi-turn consistency (Figures 6 , 10 and 11 ), and constraint preservation on an exact-format task (Figure 12 ). The assistant excerpt of the code-switching example is a sanity-gate false negative: the reply mirrors the user’s register but also claims first-person experience (“don’t ask how i know this”), which falls under the gate’s fabricated-experience class and should have been flagged. We keep the example to show this failure mode.
blocks.zh: 发布指令书的端到端实例,每个实例都显示管道如何匹配人名描述文件,在保留专题限制的同时,重新发表用户转动的声音,并横跨各行各业。 它们共同涵盖了第4和6节所讨论的行为:方言登记册(图7),被引用材料上的逐字记录(图8),代码交换(图9),跨语言重写,多回合一致(图6、10和11),以及限制对确切格式任务的保存(图12)。 密码交换的例子的助理摘录是一个疗养门假阴性:答复反映了用户的登记册,但也声称有第一人称经验( " 不要问我怎么知道这一点 " ),这属于闸门的编造经验类,应该标出。 我们保留这个例子来显示这种失败模式。

blocks.en: B.4 Feature-Level Attribution in Augmented Prompts
blocks.zh: B.4 强化提示中的特征层次归属

blocks.en: The examples above show how individual profile fields enter a rewrite, including where a rewrite goes beyond the seed request. This section asks a narrower question: can an individual profile field be held responsible for an individual span of the rewrite? Appendix F answers the aggregate version of this question by ablating one attribute at a time; here we inspect single rewrites and map fields onto the text they account for.
blocks.zh: 上面的例子显示了个人剖面字段是如何输入重写,包括重写超出种子请求的. 本节提出一个更狭义的问题:单个剖面字段能否对重写中的单个跨度负责? 附 录 F 回答这个问题的总版本时, 一次勾出一个属性; 在这里, 我们检查单个重写和将字段映射到它们所考虑的文本上 。

blocks.en: We select examples evidentially. The pipeline stores judge verdicts but no generator trace, so the available evidence is the triple of seed prompt, rewrite and profile. We therefore count a field as traceable only when its signature appears in the rewrite and is absent from the seed prompt, which rules out spans the rewriter merely copied. Scanning the released corpus on that criterion yields 31,892 turns carrying at least three independently traceable style features, and 6,062 in which background and style fields both leave marks. Figures 13 – 19 present seven of these, chosen to span the two layers of the schema and the languages of the corpus, with each field paired to the span it explains. In the first (Figure 13 ), the occupation, reference pool, volunteer interest and all three documented quirks are individually accountable for disjoint spans of the result, and the two structural style rules hold across it.
blocks.zh: 我们以证据来选择例子。 输油管储存法官的判决,但没有发电机的痕迹,所以现有的证据是种子迅速,重写和剖面的三重. 因此,我们只当一个字段的签名出现在重写中,并且没有出现在种子提示中时,才算作可以追踪的字段,因为种子提示排除了仅复制的重写字段。 根据该标准扫描释放的体积可产生31,892个转弯,其中至少有三个独立可追踪的样式特征,还有6,062个背景和样式字段都留下了标记。 图13—图19列出了其中的7个,选取了两层图案和本体语言,每个字段对接到它所解释的相间. 在第一个(图13)中,占领、参考池、志愿者兴趣和所有三个有文件记载的怪胎对结果的断裂段单独负责,两个结构样式规则贯穿其中。

blocks.en: Two patterns recur. Background fields reshape content rather than only surface form: an occupation supplies analogies and a sub-region supplies a frame of reference, in prompts whose seed text gives no occasion for either. This is not intended behavior: the rewrite prompt forbids adding new requests or persona-background content (Appendix B.1 ), and these turns are the content drift that the strict intent label flags (Appendix C ). Four of the seven examples (Figures 13 , 14 , 16 and 19 ) carry an added-content label and are excluded by the recommended strict subset; each caption states what the rewrite adds to or drops from the seed. And style rules that are stated conditionally are respected as conditions, so an emoji restricted to technical talk appears on a technical request and not on the scheduling request beside it. Conditional cases of this kind are the strongest evidence available here, since a coincidental match would not honor the condition. We note the limit of the method plainly: this is correlational evidence rather than a causal trace, and for any single token we cannot exclude chance.
blocks.zh: 两种模式重现。 背景字段重塑内容而不只是表面形式:一个占领提供类似物,而一个分区域提供参照基准,以提示方式显示,其种子文本没有给两者任何机会。 这不是有意的行为:重写提示禁止添加新的请求或个人背景内容(Appendix B.1 ),这些转弯是严格意图标签旗(Appendix C.)的内容漂移. 7个例子中的4个(图13、14、16和19)带有附加内容标签,被推荐的严格子集所排除;每个标题都说明重写对种子的增减。 而有条件地表述的风格规则作为条件受到尊重,因此限制技术谈话的emoji出现在技术请求上,而不是出现在旁边的排程请求上. 此类有条件的案件是这里现有的最有力的证据,因为偶然的比赛不符合条件。 我们注意到这一方法的局限性:这是相关证据,而不是因果关系,对于任何单一的征兆,我们不能排除机会。
