blocks.en: Appendix C Evaluation Details
blocks.zh: 附录C 评价 细节

blocks.en: This appendix collects the evaluation details behind Section 5 : the corpus-wide LLM-judge scores, two design ablations of the rewriting step, the judge-free metrics, and our checks of how much the results depend on the choice of judge.
blocks.zh: 本附录收集了第5节后面的评价细节:全元LLM法官的分数、重写步骤的两个设计分数、无法官的衡量标准,以及我们对结果在多大程度上取决于法官的选择的检查。

blocks.en: MiniMax-M2.5 , a reasoning model that is not one of the production rewriters, served with SGLang, scores every user turn of the conversations that carry a model persona (552,654 turns) and every user turn of a uniform random sample of 24,570 of the other conversations (44,687 turns). Corpus-wide rates weight the two strata by their share of the corpus’s user turns. The judge gives two independent pass/fail verdicts per turn: 1. Intent preservation: the rewrite still asks for the same thing as the original, adds no new task or invented content, and stays in the same language. 2. Style adoption: the rewrite takes on the persona’s tone, vocabulary, register or typing habits. Background facts about the persona are ignored; only a generic, unstyled rewrite fails.
blocks.zh: MiniMax-M2.5是一个推理模型,它不是制作重写机之一,服务于SGLang,对搭载模型人物a(552,654转)的对话的每个用户转会进行评分,对其他对话的24,570个统一随机抽样的每个用户转会(44,687转会)进行评分. 整个公司税率以两层人的比例为单位加权。 法官每个回合给予两个独立的通过/失败判决: 1. 意向保存:重写时仍要求与原作相同,不增加新任务或被发明的内容,并保留同文. 2. 采用样式:重写时采用人的语气、词汇、登记或打字习惯。 有关人物a的背景事实被忽略;只有一个通用的,无风格的重写失败.

blocks.en: Intent preservation: the rewrite still asks for the same thing as the original, adds no new task or invented content, and stays in the same language.
blocks.zh: 意向性保存:重写仍然要求与原作相同的东西,不增加新任务或被发明的内容,并保留同一种语言.

blocks.en: Style adoption: the rewrite takes on the persona’s tone, vocabulary, register or typing habits. Background facts about the persona are ignored; only a generic, unstyled rewrite fails.
blocks.zh: 样式收养:重写时会使用人物的语气、词汇、注册或打字习惯。 有关人物a的背景事实被忽略;只有一个通用的,无风格的重写失败.

blocks.en: Table 6: Corpus-wide LLM-judge evaluation (%, higher is better), scored by MiniMax-M2.5 and weighted to the corpus. Backbone rows refer to the model that rewrote the user turns. Judged turns: user turns scored by the judge in each row. 95% intervals are within ± \pm 0.6 points.
blocks.zh: 表6:全公司LLM法官评价(百分比,较高者更好),按Minimax-M2.5评分并加权到主体。 后骨行指重制用户转动的模型. 裁判转会:用户转会每行由裁判打分. 95%的间隔在±\pm 0.6分之内.

blocks.en: Table 6 reports the results. Three observations stand out.
blocks.zh: 表6报告了结果。 三观察出相.

blocks.en: First, the corpus-wide rates agree with the controlled study. Over the whole corpus, 96.6% of rewrites preserve intent and 67.1% adopt the persona’s style (64.9% pass both), at or above the levels of the controlled comparison in Table 1 (92.0% intent, 60 to 64% style). The controlled finding is therefore not a small-sample effect. For cross-lingual turns, which are translated before they are restyled, intent is judged against the translation, because the intent template fails any change of language by design.
blocks.zh: 首先,全体费率与控制研究一致。 在整体上,96.6%的重写保留了意图,67.1%采用了人物的作风(64.9%),在表1的控制比较水平(92.0%的意图,60至64%的作风)以上。 因此,受控的发现不是一个小样本效应. 对于跨语言的转折,在被重新整理之前就被翻译出来,意图会根据翻译来判断,因为意向模板没有通过设计实现语言的任何变化.

blocks.en: Second, the larger rewriter does better. Gemma-4-31B beats Ministral-3-14B by 4.9 points on intent and 6.6 on style, and passes both checks 9.9 points more often (68.8% against 58.9%). Preserving a complex request while writing in an informal, non-standard voice is simply harder for the smaller model.
blocks.zh: 第二,更大的重写效果更好. Gemma-4-31B在意向上以4.9分和风格上以6.6分击败了Ministry-3-14B,并更频繁地通过9.9分的检查(68.8%对58.9%). 在以非正式的、非标准的声音写作的同时保留一个复杂的请求对于较小的模型来说更困难。

blocks.en: Third, the seed data matters. Open-ended UltraChat conversations leave more room for style (76.0% style, 97.3% intent) than Nemotron’s denser, often technical instructions (65.2% style, 96.6% intent), where restyling more easily collides with strict formatting or technical wording. Real-user WildChat prompts are restyled least often (60.5% style), while intent stays at 96.0%.
blocks.zh: 三,种子数据事项. 不限成员名额的超极线 聊天对话给风格留下了更多的空间(76.0%的风格,97.3%的意向),比尼莫特龙更密集,常常是技术指令(65.2%的风格,96.6%的意向),更方便地用严格的格式或技术措辞来调和。 真实用户 Wild 聊天提示被恢复的频率最少(60.5%的风格),而意图则保持在96.0%.

blocks.en: We ablate two choices of the user-turn rewrite on 400 language-matched (free-mode) conversations per arm, with the same rewriter ( Gemma-4-31B ), judge and sanity gate, in a 2 × 2 2\times 2 design. Persona selection : a random persona that shares the prompt’s language, or the conservative matching of Section 4 (location, then top-1 embedding, then language pool). Rewrite prompt : the rewrite template alone as a single user message, or the same template wrapped in an additional system prompt that frames the rewriter as a generic text-transformation component. Table 7 shows that persona selection dominates: conservative matching raises style adoption by 22 to 23 points and also preserves intent slightly better, because a topically and geographically plausible persona gives the rewriter something concrete to express. The extra framing costs 4 to 5 points of style in both selection settings, so the pipeline uses the template alone.
blocks.zh: 我们放弃用户-回合重写每臂400个语言相配(自由模式)对话的两个选择,使用相同的重写机(Gemma-4-31B),判断和理智门,在2×2 2\times 2设计. Persona 选择 : 一个随机的人物a , 分享 point 语言, 或保守匹配 第 4 节(位置, 然后是上到1 嵌入, 然后是语言池) 。 重写快取:仅将模板重写为单一用户信息,或将同一模板包裹在附加系统快取中,将重写机设定为通用文本转换组件. 表7显示人的选择占了主导地位:保守配对将风格的采纳提升了22至23分,也保留了略好一点的意向,因为一个主题和地理上可信的人a让重写者可以表达出具体的东西. 在两种选择设置中,额外的帧成本为4到5分的样式,因此管道仅使用模板.

blocks.en: Table 7: Persona selection and rewrite prompt ablation (%, higher is better). 400 conversations per arm, about 960 judged user turns each; 95% intervals at most ± \pm 3.2 points. Bold: best per column.
blocks.zh: 表 7: 人物选择和重写快报(%,更高更好) 每臂有400个会话,大约960个判断的用户各转;95%的间隔最多为±\pm 3.2分. 粗体:每列最好.

blocks.en: We compare two ways of producing cross-lingual user turns on the same 300 conversations, personas and rewriter ( Gemma-4-31B ): single pass , where the source turn is re-voiced directly into the persona’s language, and translate, then restyle , where each turn is first translated literally into that language and the translation is then restyled with the same-language rewrite. Both variants are judged against the same literal translation of the turn, because the intent template fails any language switch by design, and the target language is checked with fastText language identification. Table 8 shows that the two-step variant keeps the request more often, reaches the target language more often and passes the sanity gate slightly more often, while the single pass adopts the persona’s style slightly more often. We use the two-step variant, since a rewrite that drifts from the request or out of the target language defeats the purpose of the cross-lingual mode.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了两种制作跨语言用户打开相同300个对话, 人物和再写(Gemma-4-31B): 单传, 源代码直接被重新拼入人物语言, 两种变体都根据转弯的同一种字面翻译来判断,因为意向模板通过设计失败了任何语言切换,目标语言通过快取Text语言识别来检查. 表8显示,双步变体更经常地保留请求,更经常地到达目标语言,并略多地通过疗养门,而单行道则略多地采用人物风格. 我们使用双步变体,因为从请求中漂移出或从目标语言中漂移出的一个重写会挫败跨语言模式的目的.

blocks.en: Table 8: Cross-lingual rewriting strategy (%, higher is better). 300 conversations per variant, about 730 judged user turns each, same personas, rewriter and judge; 95% intervals at most ± \pm 3.6 points. Bold: best per column.
blocks.zh: 表8:跨语种重写战略(百分比,较高更好) 每个变体300个对话,大约730个判断的用户各转,同一个人,重写和判断;95%的间隔最多为±\pm 3.6分. 粗体:每列最好.

blocks.en: These metrics use no LLM judge, so they are free of judge bias. They fall into two groups: how much a rewrite changes the text and what it keeps intact, and how closely it follows the style values in the persona’s profile.
blocks.zh: 这些衡量标准没有使用LLM法官,因此没有法官偏见. 它们分为两组:重写对文本的修改程度和保持什么完好无损,以及它如何接近人物简介中的风格值.

blocks.en: Each metric checks the rewrite against the matching attribute in the persona’s profile: • Emoji & emoticon register: Text is matched against Unicode 15.0 emoji codepoints, ASCII emoticons (e.g., :-) , <3 ), and kaomoji (e.g., (^_^) , orz ). A turn passes if it satisfies its target persona tier: none (0 emojis/emoticons), rare/functional ( ≤ 2 \leq 2 functional emojis), frequent/decorative ( ≥ 1 \geq 1 decorative emoji), or kaomoji ( ≥ 1 \geq 1 kaomoji pattern). • Capitalization register: For cased scripts, sentence-start capitalization and casing proportions are verified against target profiles: all-lowercase ( ≥ 70 % \geq 70\% lowercase or 0 capitalized sentence starts), standard ( ≥ 70 % \geq 70\% capitalized sentence starts), first-word-only (only the initial turn character capitalized, without terminal periods), and all-caps (presence of new capitalized tokens for emphasis). • Punctuation register: Evaluates line-ending periods, ellipses ( ... ), linebreaks, and expressive punctuation ( !! , ?? ) against persona categories: standard ( ≥ 70 % \geq 70\% punctuated line endings), minimal / drops period (omission of terminal periods), ellipsis-heavy , and expressive . • Length ratio short/medium/long: Median length ratio | s rw | | s orig | \frac{|s_{\text{rw}}|}{|s_{\text{orig}}|} conditioned on the persona’s specified verbosity tendency ( Short , Medium , Long ), corroborated by a positive Spearman rank correlation.

blocks.en: All style and intent scores in the paper come from LLM judges, so we measure how much they depend on which judge is used. We re-score a stratified set of 100 persona rewrites (spanning the sixteen single-attribute conditions of Appendix F ) with four independent judges ( Gemma-4-31B , GLM-4.7-Flash , Ministral-3-14B , MiniMax-M2.5 ), each issuing a binary style-adoption and intent-preservation verdict per rewrite. Table 10 reports each judge’s mean verdict rate and Table 11 the pairwise item-level agreement.
blocks.zh: 论文中所有的风格和意向分数都出自LLM评委,所以我们衡量它们在多大程度上依赖于使用哪个评委. 我们重新评分一套由100人重写(扩展附录F的16个单属性条件)的分级评委,由4名独立评委(Gemma-4-31B,GLM-4.7-Flash,Ministal-3-14B,MiniMax-M2.5)组成,每个评委每重写一次发布二进制样式采纳和意向保留裁定. 表10为每位法官的平均判决率,表11为对等的项目级协议。

blocks.en: The judges differ most in how lenient they are, most visibly on style, where MiniMax-M2.5 is strictest and GLM-4.7-Flash most lenient: mean style pass rates range from 0.78 to 0.93. Raw agreement on individual items is high (0.82 to 0.90 on style) and looser on intent (0.73 to 0.94), but part of that is expected by chance when most items pass, so raw agreement overstates consistency. Table 12 corrects for this. Chance-corrected agreement is moderate to strong for pairs with comparable pass rates, and every pair involving the production judge ( MiniMax-M2.5 ) reaches κ ≥ 0.32 \kappa\geq 0.32 on style and κ ≥ 0.22 \kappa\geq 0.22 on intent, with the strongest agreement between MiniMax-M2.5 and Gemma-4-31B on intent ( κ = 0.86 \kappa=0.86 ). The near-zero style κ \kappa between GLM-4.7-Flash and Ministral-3-14B arises because both pass more than 92% of items, which leaves little variance to agree on; AC1, which corrects for this prevalence effect, is 0.85 for the same pair. The effective sample is 99 items for the style verdicts and 100 for intent. In short, a result obtained with one judge carries over to the others in direction, while absolute pass rates depend on the judge; this is why we report the external re-judging below rather than relying on a single judge.
blocks.zh: 评委们在风格上表现的宽大程度差异最大,在风格上最为明显,Minimax-M2.5最严格,而GLM-4.7-Flash最宽大:平均风格通过率从0.78到0.93. 关于单个项目的原始协议很高(0.82到0.90在风格上),关于意图的原始协议比较松散(0.73到0.94),但当大多数项目通过时,其中一部分是偶然预期的,因此原始协议过分地表述了一致性. 表12正确无误。 概率校正协议对于通过率相仿的对子来说是中度到强度的,每对涉及制作裁判员(MiniMax-M2.5 )的对子在风格上达到0.32\kappa\geq0.32,在意图上达到0.22\kappa\geq0.22,而MiniMax-M2.5和Gemma-4-31B在意图上最强烈的一致(0.86\kappa=0.86). GLM-4.7-Flash和Ministal-3-14B之间近为零的正式为"\kappa",因为两者都通过了超过92%的物品,因此没有多少差异来达成一致;AC1纠正了这种流行效应,对同一对来说是0.85. 有效的样本是99件用于样式判决和100件用于意图。 简言之,通过一名法官获得的结果会向其他法官转移,而绝对通过率则取决于法官;这就是为什么我们报告外部重新判断在下面而不是依赖一名法官的原因。

blocks.en: All four judges above are also rewriters or the production judge of the pipeline, so they are not fully independent of it. We therefore re-score all 518 stored pairs of the A/B in Table 1 , with the flat and structured rewrites in a per-item random order, using MiniMax-M2.5 with a larger output budget and three judges from outside the pipeline, served through a separate inference stack. Table 13 and Figure 20 report the results. The larger budget recovers 514 of 518 verdicts for MiniMax-M2.5 , which shows that the attrition in the original pass (433 of 518) came from truncated reasoning rather than from the items, and reproduces its direction (62.4% against 64% of decisive verdicts for structured). All three external judges prefer the structured representation; the effect is clear for both Qwen models and small for DeepSeek-V4-Flash , whose interval touches parity. Intent preservation is identical for the two representations under every judge.
blocks.zh: 以上四位评委也都是重写员或管线的生产评委,因此不完全独立于管线. 因此,我们将表1中储存的518对A/B重新计分,平面和结构重写按每个项目的随机顺序进行,使用产出预算较大的MiniMax-M2.5和管道外的3名法官,通过一个单独的推论堆服务。 表13和图20报告了结果。 较大的预算收回了518起对MiniMax-M2.5的判决中的514起,这表明原证(518起中的433起)的自然减员来自于断断续续的推理而非项目,并照搬了它的方向(62.4%对64%的结构性决定性判决). 所有三名外聘裁判都更喜欢结构化的代表;效果对于Quen模型和对于DeepSeek-V4-Flash都很明显,其间隔触及到等. 每名法官的两种陈述都具有同样的意向。

blocks.en:
Following Pagan et al. (2026) , we test detectability in two
settings. On synthetic seeds, the primary use case of the pipeline, a stylometric classifier separates real WildChat
user turns from UltraChat and Nemotron originals and, separately, from their rewrites. Rewriting moves typing toward
real users, and detection drops by 15.1 points [13.8, 16.5]: Synthetic seeds, original Rewritten Real users Lowercase start 0.5% 43% 27% Missing final punctuation 3% 47% 55% Stylometric detection 91.3% 76.2% n/a Fine-tuned encoders still separate both the originals and the rewrites from WildChat, because the topics of synthetic
seeds differ; the pipeline keeps the request, so this topic gap is expected. On real WildChat turns in the paired
setting, a fine-tuned XLM-R distinguishes a real turn from our rewrite of it at 84.6% accuracy and from a persona-free
paraphrase at 75.9%, while stylometric features alone reach 68.2%. This matches the main finding of Pagan et al.:
LLM-generated text stays distinguishable for a trained classifier, and pushing it toward human-likeness costs semantic
fidelity. Our pipeline sits on the fidelity side by design, as it keeps the original request.

blocks.en:
Section 5 compares a structured style representation against a free-text one
within our own schema. This appendix asks the same question against the formats the field
actually uses: PersonaHub ( Ge et al., 2025 ) and SynthPAI ( Yukhymenko et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
第5节将结构化的样式代表与自由文本代表进行比较
在我们自己的计划。 本附录针对字段的格式提出同样的问题。
实际用途:PersonaHub(Ge等人,2025年)和SynthPAI(Yukhymenko等人,2024年).

blocks.en:
We hold the persona content fixed and vary only its
serialization. From the released corpus we sample 800 conversations, stratified by persona
set and seed source, together with the persona the pipeline matched to each. Sampling is
independent of the released sanity verdict, and every condition is regenerated from
scratch, so no condition inherits an advantage from the corpus filtering. Each profile is
then rendered four ways and used to rewrite the same seed prompt with the same rewriter,
decoding parameters, judge and prompt scaffold. Only the persona block differs.

blocks.en:
The PersonaHub rendering is a single third-person sentence. This is not a simplification
on our part: across all 200,000 released PersonaHub personas, only 1.4% mention any
writing cue at all, so a projection that described typing behavior would not be testing
PersonaHub. The SynthPAI rendering keeps the feature types that schema has, an attribute
block plus a free-text writing-style description with a verbatim example, and drops the
per-axis style keys, which it has no slot for. Projections were produced by a third model
that is neither rewriter nor judge, and were accepted only after matching the real
PersonaHub length distribution and style-mention rate. Table 15 reports what
survives each rendering.

blocks.en:
Table 16 and Figure 23 show a dose-response in how explicitly a
representation encodes writing behavior. Style adoption rises monotonically across the
four conditions, and the judge prefers the PersonaFactory rewrite in every pairwise
comparison (share of items where the judge prefers the PersonaFactory rewrite, with order randomized per item). Style adoption and intent use the production judge templates; paired bootstrap intervals for the judge-free differences are at most ± \pm 0.05. The contested comparison is against the SynthPAI form, which also carries style
information and differs from ours mainly in whether that information is structured; there
the preference is 4.83 to 1.

Two observations do not follow from the setup. First, the PersonaHub form is not inert. It
moves the rewrite away from the no-persona baseline about as far as the other conditions do,
yet lifts style adoption only from 3.1% to 5.5%: it changes the text without changing it
toward the persona. Second, the representation propagates past the user turn. Measured
against the no-persona reply for the same item, the assistant’s response moves further as
the representation grows richer, while assistant sanity stays flat across conditions, so
this is a change of register rather than of quality.

The gains are not free, and the cost is concentrated rather than uniform.
Intent preservation is essentially unaffected in English but falls to 89.2% on the
cross-lingual half, and entity retention declines by four points. Transformation-depth
metrics also fall, but those measure how much the surface changed and are the intended
effect rather than a loss.

blocks.en: In the comparison above, the style and pairwise judges see the persona rendered in the PersonaFactory format, which the PersonaFactory rewriter also saw, so a rewrite could in principle score by echoing phrasing from its own prompt. We therefore re-judge the same 3,200 rewrites against a format-neutral reference that lists only the persona’s writing-behaviour attribute values (structured typing keys, sentence length, question framing, code-switching frequency) with all example phrasing removed, using the pipeline judge and two external judges ( Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and Muse-Glimmer-30B ). We also rewrite every item with a real PersonaHub persona and a real SynthPAI profile in their native form, with the same rewriter and template, and compare each with the PersonaFactory rewrite in a reference-free pairwise judgment of which rewrite gives the message a more distinctive and realistic individual voice while keeping the request intact. Figure 21 shows that PersonaFactory keeps the highest style adoption under every judge and is preferred over both projected formats and over real PersonaHub personas, with every interval above parity. Real SynthPAI profiles, whose hand-written style descriptions cover 300 English-speaking Reddit users, are on par with PersonaFactory; they are preferred on cross-lingual prompts, where our persona speaks a different language than the prompt, while PersonaFactory scales the same style fidelity to a bank of nearly 100,000 multilingual profiles with per-axis control.

blocks.en: Stronger stylization has a cost. In a reference-free judgment of whether a message reads as something a real person would type or as a caricature, the pipeline judge passes 99% of rewrites in every condition, but the two external judges rate PersonaFactory rewrites 7 to 12 points less natural than unconditioned rewrites. We attribute this to the richer behaviour specification: a profile that asks for lowercase typing, dropped punctuation, abbreviations, emoji and a sign-off at the same time invites the rewriter to realize several markers in one short message, which a judge can read as over-performed, whereas formats that specify little change little. The per-turn quirk probability has no consistent effect on this; an explicit cap on the number of markers realized per turn does, as the next paragraph shows.
blocks.zh: 更强的分层化是有代价的. 在无参考的判断中,一个消息是读作一个真实的人会打字还是漫画,管道法官在每个条件上都会通过99%的重写,但两位外部法官对PersonaFactory重写7到12分的评分比无条件重写低. 我们将此归因于内容更丰富的行为规格:一个要求小写打字,放出平分,缩写,emoji和签出同时邀请重写者在一个短信息中实现数个标记,法官可以将其读取为超效,而很少指定变化的格式. 每转弯的概率对此没有一致的影响;如下段所示,对每转弯实现的标记数量有明确的上限.

blocks.en:
We evaluated p = 0.10 p=0.10 , 0.15 and 0.25, each with and without a cap of two realized chat markers per turn (greeting,
sign-off, emoji, slang, ellipsis, repeated punctuation). The cap is an instruction in the rewrite prompt, not a
post-hoc filter, so it changes how the whole turn is written. To compare like with like, all settings were generated
fresh on the 646 of the 800 items of Table 2 that pass the pipeline’s checks in all six settings
(so the uncapped values differ from Table 2 ), with the reference formats and real user turns in the
same table: Setting ( Gemma-4-31B ) Style adoption Same request Naturalness (Muse-Glimmer) p = 0.10 p=0.10 to 0.25, no cap 63.0 to 64.6 88.5 to 90.7 83.1 to 83.9 p = 0.10 p=0.10 to 0.25, cap 52.9 to 57.6 89.0 to 89.8 87.6 to 88.7 SynthPAI format (no cap) 46.1 90.2 87.0 No persona 3.7 94.6 91.3 Real WildChat user turns n/a n/a 94.2 With the cap, our rewrites are as natural as the SynthPAI-format rewrites while adopting 7 to 11 points more of the
persona’s style, at the same intent preservation; a second judge ( Qwen3.6-35B-A3B ) shows the same picture.
Capped rewrites remain 2.6 to 3.7 points less natural than rewrites without any persona, which is the cost of adopting
a style at all. The quirk probability p p has no consistent effect; the cap is the effective lever and our recommended
setting. The representational result of Table 1 holds under the cap: with both arms
regenerated with the cap, the structured style layer remains preferred under all three judges, with a smaller margin
(62.0 to 65.1% of decisive verdicts without the cap, 54.9 to 58.1% with it). On real WildChat seeds with both
rewriters, the cap likewise trades a few points of style for 4 to 5 points of naturalness at about 99% intent
preservation. The corpus was generated with p = 0.25 p=0.25 and the prompt’s instruction to use at most two stylistic
elements, but without the explicit cap: 97.3% of its user turns contain at most two of the six markers, while
greetings and emoji remain more frequent than in real user turns. We will add a per-turn marker count to the release so
that users can filter by marker density, and make the cap the default in the released code.

blocks.en: To see whether the style layer moves rewrites towards real users or past them, we convert 2,140 Nemotron-Personas and PersonaHub records into our format and rewrite the same seed turns three ways, changing only the persona text that the rewriter and responder see: (A) the raw source record, (B) our converted background without a style layer, and (C) the background with the generated style layer. On the 182 English WildChat seeds that pass in all three arms, we then ask three judges which of two messages reads more like something a real person typed, pairing each rewrite with the real WildChat message it came from. Every pair is judged in both orders; a win requires the same choice in both, and a flip counts as a draw. Without a style layer, the judges pick the real message more often than the rewrite. With it, every judge prefers the rewrite over the real message (Table 14 ). Figure 22 shows why: the style layer brings lowercase starts and missing final punctuation to the rates of real users, but realizes greetings, chat slang, emoji, ellipses and repeated punctuation several times more often than real users do. The same markers are over-represented in a sample of the released corpus, so a judge preference for a rewrite over the original should be read as more casual typing, not as closer realism. The marker cap above addresses this; calibrating marker rates exactly to real-user frequencies remains a target for future versions of the pipeline.

blocks.en: Appendix E Human Study
blocks.zh: 附录E 人类研究

blocks.en:
In this section we describe the expert human study that complements the LLM-judge evaluation of
Section 5 . We first describe the study design (§ E.1 ), then give the
information and instructions shown to participants (§ E.2 ), the ethics review and
compensation (§ E.3 ), the interim results (§ E.4 ), and example items
(§ E.7 ).
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们描述了补充LLM法官对以下内容的评价的专家人类研究:
第5节 我们首先描述研究设计(§E.1),然后给出
向参与者显示的信息和指示(E.2节)、道德操守审查和
赔偿(第E.3节)、临时结果(第E.4节)和实例项目
(E.7节)。

blocks.en: E.1 Study Description
blocks.zh: E.1 研究说明

blocks.en:
The study uses one form per language, 60 languages in total, each administered as a self-paced online
session. A form contains up to 40 items, ten in each of four parts; forms for languages with fewer available
samples contain fewer items. Participants are experts in the AI field who rate only the language varieties
they know well. They may complete up to three sessions, one per language, and are identified only by a random
participant ID. The four parts measure different properties and are never combined into a single score:
blocks.zh:
该研究使用每种语言的1个表格,总共60个语言,每个语言作为自行节奏在线管理
届会。 表格中最多包含40个项目,每四个部分各10个;可供使用的语文表格较少
样本中包含的物品较少。 学员是AI领域的专家,只评定语言品种

blocks.en: Study information

blocks.en:
Purpose. This study evaluates a research pipeline that rewrites the user side of chat conversations
so that language-model training data better reflects how linguistically diverse people write (informal
register, second-language phrasing, code-switching) while preserving meaning. As an expert in the AI field,
you judge properties of displayed texts. The study analyzes texts and models, not you; no analyses of
individual participants are performed.

目标。 本研究评价重写聊天对话用户端的研究管道
以便语文模式培训数据更好地反映不同语言的人如何写作(非正式的)
注册、第二语言措辞、代码交换),同时保留意义。 作为AI领域的专家,
您判断已显示文本的属性。 该研究分析了文本和模型,而不是你;没有分析
进行个人参与。

blocks.en:
What participation involves. Each item shows one or two short chat messages with a rating question
(meaning preservation, style fidelity, human-vs-LLM origin judgment, or linguistic plausibility). Some tasks
ask you to judge whether a displayed text was written by a human or generated by a language model; the origin
of each text is therefore not disclosed before you answer. This task structure is openly described here and
involves no other withheld information. This session contains 40 study items. Completion time varies with
reading pace and breaks. You may complete up to 3 sessions, one per language.

The study was reviewed and approved by the ethics review board (IRB) of the authors’ institution and

blocks.en: E.4 Results
blocks.zh: E.4 结果

blocks.en:
We report an interim snapshot of the study. It contains 11 submissions covering nine languages with 476
assigned item evaluations; only German and Vietnamese currently have two submissions each. All saved
submissions are included without exclusions. Pooled statistics weight available ratings equally, not
languages equally, and standard deviations describe dispersion, not uncertainty in the mean.
Table 18 gives pooled ratings, Table 19 the per-language means,
Table 20 the Part C judgments, and Table 22 the agreement between the two
German and the two Vietnamese submissions. Each language is rated on its own panel of items, so per-language differences can reflect
item selection and rater severity as well as language quality; these means are not a language ranking. In Part C, a text counts as a verified model rewrite if it matches a user message of the corpus exactly; the remaining texts are human-written user turns sampled from WildChat (the 44 verified judgments cover 34 distinct texts). The agreement estimates rest on few
shared items and are exploratory, and agreement does not imply accuracy.

提交材料不排除在外。 汇总统计加权数相同,不

blocks.en:
We also give the Part C texts of all answered panels (68 texts: 34 verified
rewrites and 34 chat-log texts) to four LLM judges, Claude Sonnet 4.5 , MiniMax-M2.5 , Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and Muse-Glimmer-30B . Every judge sees the question and answer options shown to
the raters and returns a JSON answer (human or model) with a confidence from 1 to 5; LLM judges answer each text three times. The three open-weight judges
are served locally ( MiniMax-M2.5 with SGLang, the other two with vLLM) with their default chat templates
and reasoning, and receive one text per request through the chat API; each text is sampled three times at
temperature 0.7 with up to 8,192 new tokens, and the answer is read from the final JSON object. Claude Sonnet 4.5 is queried in three independent sessions without tool access, each receiving all 68 texts
in one prompt under neutral ids in a shuffled order and judging each text independently. It is run through the
Claude Code agent interface, whose sampling parameters are fixed by the provider and not user-configurable. All 816 answers parse. We do not
use Gemma-4-31B as a judge because it wrote part of the rewrites. For accuracy, the chat-log texts
count as human-written by study design, although they are not individually verified; the human-rater accuracy
uses the same convention over the 85 answered judgments. Table 21 reports
the results. All judges label most rewrites as human-written (83.3 to 89.2%), more often than the raters
(59.1%), and none separates the two sources clearly above chance (50.5 to 57.4% accuracy).

重写和34个聊天日志文本),由4位LLM评委克洛德·索内特(Claude Sonnet 4.5),MiniMax-M2.5.,Qune3.6-35B-A3B和Muse-Glimer-30B. 每个法官都会看到问答的选项

和推理,并通过聊天API收到每个请求一个文本;每个文本在
温度为0.7,最多为8,192个新符号,答案取自最终的JSON对象. Claude Sonnet 4.5在3个独立会议中被询问,没有工具访问,每个会议都收到全部68个文本
在一个中性标识下按被洗涤的顺序 独立判断每个文本。 它运行在

blocks.en: E.6 Scope of the Human Study in Context
blocks.zh: E.6 人类研究的范围

blocks.en:
The study follows an IRB-approved protocol classified as minimal risk (§ E.3 ). Its instrument
was prepared for 60 languages and has four parts (A meaning preservation, B style fidelity, C human or model with
confidence, D linguistic plausibility); raters are unpaid volunteer experts in the AI field who rate only language
varieties they know well, give informed consent, and are identified by random participant IDs.
blocks.zh:
这项研究遵循了IRB核准的被归类为最低风险的协议(E.3节)。 其文书
为60种语言编写,有四个部分(A含义保存、B风格忠诚、C人或模型
信心,D语言可信度; 评分员是AI领域的无报酬志愿者专家,只评分语言
并且通过随机的参与者标识来识别。

blocks.en:
At the time of writing, the study has 11 submissions in nine languages (Bosnian, Bulgarian, Croatian, English,
German, Greek, Serbian, Ukrainian, Vietnamese) with 476 assigned item evaluations; German and Vietnamese have two
submissions each, the others one. The texts use three scripts (Latin, Cyrillic, Greek), and the languages come from
the Slavic, Germanic and Hellenic branches of Indo-European and from Austroasiatic. Only English and German are
high-resource; the others are mid- or lower-resource. Related human evaluations are compared below (IRB: “no”
means not mentioned, “n/a” means no external raters).

Human studies of synthetic personas with larger rater pools are English-only and recruit paid workers on

blocks.en: Appendix F Per-attribute Augmentation Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录F 增强分析

blocks.en: Aggregate fidelity tells us that persona conditioning works, but not which part of a profile is doing the work or what it costs. We therefore run a controlled, one-attribute-at-a-time ablation that decomposes the augmentation into three separately measured aspects. To our knowledge, prior user-simulation and persona-conditioning work reports fidelity only in aggregate; a per-attribute decomposition of a persona-augmentation pipeline is, to our knowledge, new.
blocks.zh: 整体忠诚告诉我们,人性调节是可行的,但不是一个剖面图的哪一部分在做这项工作或花费多少。 因此,我们进行一个可控、一次性的消散,将扩增分为三个单独计量的方面。 据我们所知,先前的用户模拟和人气调节工作只报告整体忠诚;据我们所知,人气增强管道的每个属性分解是新的。

blocks.en: From a stratified pool of up to 194 real source messages, we build single-attribute personas: a no-persona baseline plus sixteen conditions that vary exactly one attribute and collapse into eight families (digital fluency, sentence length, AI stance, age, gender, education, occupation, hobbies). Each condition is rewritten by all four generators ( Gemma-4-31B , Ministral-3-14B , GLM-4.7-Flash , MiniMax-M2.5 ), holding everything else fixed, for 12,845 valid rewrites. Every rewrite is scored on three orthogonal aspects: style adoption (does the turn take on the attribute’s register?), intent preservation (is it still the same request in the same language?), and rule-based script stability ; the no-persona baseline fixes the script-stability ceiling at 0.987. Table 23 reports the eight families, averaged over the four generators; Figure 24 gives the full per-condition grid behind it.
blocks.zh: 从多达194个真实源信息的分层集合中,我们构建了单一属性的人物:一个无人基线加上16个条件,这些条件完全不同一个属性,并倒向了8个家庭(数字流利、句子长度、AI姿态、年龄、性别、教育、职业、爱好)。 每个条件都由所有4个发电机(Gemma-4-31B,Ministryal-3-14B,GLM-4.7-Flash,MiniMax-M2.5)重写,持有其他所有固定设备,共12,845个有效重写. 每个重写都得分在三个正统方面:样式的采用(转接属性的收录器吗?),意向保留(是否还是同一语言的请求?),以及基于规则的脚本稳定性;无人基线将脚本稳定性上限固定为0.987. 表23报告这8个家庭,平均分布在4个发电机上;图24显示了后面的每个条件的电网。

blocks.en: Table 23: Per-attribute augmentation analysis (share of rewrites, higher is better). One persona attribute varied at a time, averaged over four generators; script stability is relative to the no-persona baseline.
blocks.zh: 表23: 分配性增益分析(重写份额,较高部分较好)。 一个人a属性一次不同,平均超过4个发电机;脚本稳定性与无人基线相对.

blocks.en: We present these numbers as a measurement, not an importance ranking. Across all eight families, style adoption sits in a narrow 0.80–0.82 band, intent preservation clusters near 0.62, and script stability decrements uniformly by roughly 0.06–0.07 from the no-persona baseline. We deliberately avoid ordering attributes by effect size: the between-attribute spread (at most ≈ \approx 0.02 in style adoption) is smaller than the cross-generator and sampling variation, so no single attribute is separably “more important.” In the full per-condition grid (Figure 24 ), which puts all three axes on one 0 0 – 1 1 scale, the columns sit at clearly different levels while the rows within a column barely move. The informative signal is the uniformity itself, and it supports a negative statement only: within the precision of this probe, no background attribute is separably more influential than another, and conditioning on any of them costs a small, roughly constant script-stability decrement. It does not show that each attribute is individually effective, and none of the structured style keys is ablated here.
blocks.zh: 我们把这些数字作为衡量尺度,而不是重要的排名。 所有8个家庭的收养风格都以0.80-0.82个小带为主,意向保护集群接近0.62个,脚本稳定性从无人基线统一下降约0.06-0.07个。 我们刻意避免按效果大小来排序属性:属性之间的分布(在样式采纳中大多数为\\\\ 0. 02)小于跨生成器和采样变异,所以没有单一属性可以分隔出“更重要”的. 在将所有三轴都放入一 0 – 1 个比例尺的全条件网格(图 24 )中,柱子的位置明显不同,而柱子内的行几乎不动. 信息信号是统一性本身,它只支持否定的表述:在这个探测器的精确度内,没有哪个背景属性比另一个属性更有分辨的影响,对其中任何一个属性的限定都花费了少量的,大致恒定的脚本稳定性减速. 它没有显示每个属性都是单个有效的,这里没有结构化的样式密钥被淡出.

blocks.en: The variation that dominates is the rewriter, not the attribute, as Figure 25 makes plain: style adoption spans barely 0.02 0.02 across the eight attribute families but 0.35 0.35 across the four rewriters. On identical conditions it ranges from ≈ \approx 0.61 (GLM) to ≈ \approx 0.96 (Ministral), and it trades off against intent preservation (Ministral ≈ \approx 0.38 vs. Gemma ≈ \approx 0.77 and MiniMax ≈ \approx 0.77), consistent with more aggressive restyling costing more intent. Ministral also has the lowest script stability ( 0.85 0.85 against Gemma’s 0.98 0.98 ), so the three panels tell one story: the most eager restyler is also the least faithful one, while Gemma is the balanced choice, which is the same responder gap that shows up at corpus scale in Section 6 . This is exactly why the main-text comparison (Section 5 ) fixes the rewriter to isolate style representation , and why we report multi-judge agreement rather than trusting a single evaluator. The ablation here is a controlled probe on a stratified sample; it complements, rather than replaces, the corpus-scale metrics of Section 6 .
blocks.zh: 占主导地位的变体是重写,而不是属性,如图25所说明的:风格收养在8个属性家族中仅仅跨度为0.02 0.02分,而四个重写家族则相差0.35 0.35分. 在相同的条件下,它从 \\ 大约 0.61 (GLM) 至 \\ 大约 0.96 (部委) , 它与意图保全进行交易( 部委 \\\ 大约 0.38 vs. Gemma \\\ 大约 0. 77 和 MiniMax \\ 大约 0. 77 ) , 符合更积极的重新定居, 花费更多的意图。 Ministry也有最低的剧本稳定性(0.85 0.85 与 Gemma 0.98 0.98 相對),因此三个板块讲述一个故事:最热心的 restyler 也是最不忠实的;而 Gemma 则是平衡的选择,这是第6节中以实体尺度显示的相同响应者差距. 正因为如此,主文比较(第5节)确定重写者将风格代表隔离开来,我们报告多法官协议而不是相信一个评价者。 这里的衰减是分层样本上的受控探测器;它补充而不是取代了第6节的生物量度测量标准。

blocks.en: Figure 24: Every single-attribute condition scored on the three fidelity axes, averaged over the four rewriters, on one shared 0 0 – 1 1 scale. The no-persona baseline has no rewrite, hence no style or intent score.
blocks.zh: 图24:每个单属性条件在三个忠诚轴上得分,平均在四个重写器上得分,一个共享0–1分. 无人基线没有重写,因此没有样式或意图分数.

blocks.en: Figure 25: The same ablation summarized per rewriter, averaged over all sixteen attribute conditions.
blocks.zh: 图25:每部重写机的相同减值汇总,平均为所有16个属性条件.

blocks.en: Appendix G Conversational Corpus
blocks.zh: 附录G 对话 企业

blocks.en: G.1 Stylized Corpus Details
blocks.zh: G.1 上层化公司细节

blocks.en: English is the largest language of the released corpus, with a long multilingual tail. Of the ≈ \approx 1.24M conversations, 472,297 (38.2%) start with an English user turn. The rest are spread over 84 other languages, led by Chinese (67.8k conversations), Spanish (66.0k), Russian (60.1k) and French (51.8k). All 13 macro-regions of the persona sampling grid appear, but not evenly: Western Europe (210.6k), Southeast Asia (166.0k), North America (160.1k) and Sub-Saharan Africa (102.9k) account for the largest shares, which is the skew we discuss in Section 7 . This shape is not an artefact of one seed dataset. WildChat supplies most conversations in every top language, but UltraChat and Nemotron contribute to every language and region and supply most of the Western European, North American and Oceanian conversations. Figure 26 shows both breakdowns.
blocks.zh: 英语是被放出教程中最大的语言,有很长的多语言尾巴. 在\\\ 大约1.24M的谈话中,472,297(38.2%)从英语用户回合开始. 其余分布于84种其他语言上,以汉语(67.8k对话),西班牙语(66.0k),俄语(60.1k)和法语(51.8k)为主. 人种采样网的所有13个宏观区域都出现了,但并不均匀:西欧(210.6k),东南亚(166.0k),北美(160.1k)和撒哈拉以南非洲(102.9k)占了最大的份额,这是我们在第7节中讨论的摇摆. 这个形状并不是一个种子数据集的外形. WildChat以每种顶级语言提供大部分对话,但UltraChat和Nemotron为每一种语言和区域作出贡献,并供应了大部分西欧,北美和大洋洲的对话. 图26显示了这两个细目。

blocks.en: Figure 26: Distribution of the released chat dataset: (a) top 10 non-English languages (detected language of the first user turn), and (b) top 10 persona macro-regions.
blocks.zh: 图26:发布聊天数据集的分布 (a)前十名非英语语言(被检测为第一个用户回合的语言), (b)前十名人物a宏区域.

blocks.en: About 94% of released user turns are rewritten in the persona’s voice. The remaining 6% (146,643 turns) are kept unchanged on purpose. We spell out why, because a turn that was deliberately protected looks the same from the outside as one where the rewriter failed. There are five reasons (the remaining 0.2% are rewriter calls that timed out): • Truncation (21.6%, 31,716 turns): the rewrite came back much shorter than the original, which usually means content was lost rather than restyled. • Strict-format tasks (14.4%, 21,116): verbatim repetition, translation or quoted-output requests, where restyling would break exactly what the user asked for. • Lost protected content (31.0%, 45,453): every retry dropped a protected quote, code span or number. • Script or language change (29.1%, 42,607): the rewrite switched the script or language of the turn, or the persona’s language did not match the script of the prompt. • No change (3.7%, 5,460): the rewriter returned the message as it was. In each of these cases we prefer to ship the original turn over a broken request or a language mismatch.
blocks.zh: 大约94%的释放出用户转弯都是用人的声音重写. 其余6%(146,643个转弯)是有意维持不变的。 我们阐述了原因,因为一个被故意保护的转弯,从外部看,与重写失败的转弯相同. 有五个原因(剩下的0.2%是重写已超时的呼号): • 截断(21.6%,31,716个转弯):重写回来的时间比原作要短得多,这通常意味着内容丢失了,而不是被重新恢复. • 严格格式的任务(14.4%、21 116):逐字记录、翻译或引出产出请求,重新整理将完全打破用户的要求。 被保护内容丢失(31.0%,45,453):每次重试都会掉入被保护的引文,代码跨度或编号. • 脚本或语言变化(29.1%,42,607):重写时切换了转弯的脚本或语言,或者人物的语言与提示的脚本不相匹配. 无变化(3.7%,5,460):重写者按原样返回了消息. 在每种情况下,我们都倾向于将原转弯运出一个被中断的请求或语言错配。

blocks.en: Truncation (21.6%, 31,716 turns): the rewrite came back much shorter than the original, which usually means content was lost rather than restyled.
blocks.zh: 截取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取

blocks.en: Strict-format tasks (14.4%, 21,116): verbatim repetition, translation or quoted-output requests, where restyling would break exactly what the user asked for.
blocks.zh: 严格格式任务(14.4%,21.116):逐字记录重复,翻译或引用输出请求,重新整理会完全打破用户的要求.

blocks.en: Lost protected content (31.0%, 45,453): every retry dropped a protected quote, code span or number.
blocks.zh: 被保护内容丢失(31.0%,45,453):每次重试都会掉入被保护的引文,代码跨度或编号.

blocks.en: Script or language change (29.1%, 42,607): the rewrite switched the script or language of the turn, or the persona’s language did not match the script of the prompt.
blocks.zh: 脚本或语言变化(29.1%,42,607):重写时切换了转弯时的脚本或语言,或者人物的语言不符合提示的脚本.

blocks.en: No change (3.7%, 5,460): the rewriter returned the message as it was.
blocks.zh: 无变化(3.7%,5,460):重写者按原样返回了消息.

blocks.en: One number may look surprisingly low: code-switching markers appear in only 1.95% of user turns (measured on the 552,654 user turns of conversations with a model persona), although many more personas are described as code-switchers. This is intended. Linguistic quirks are applied with a fixed probability rather than at every opportunity, because a persona that uses every mannerism in every message reads as a caricature rather than a person (Section 4 ). Each quirk is meant to be rare in a single turn and visible across the corpus.
blocks.zh: 一个数字看起来可能令人惊讶地很低:代码开关标记只出现在1.95%的用户转弯(以552,654个用户转弯与模型人物a的对话来衡量),尽管更多的人被描述为代码开关. 这是有意的。 语言怪异的应用有固定的概率,而不是在每个机会,因为使用每条信息中的每一种礼仪的人物读作漫画而不是一个人(第4节. 每一个怪胎在一次转弯中都是罕见的,并且在整个体外可见.

blocks.en: Each seed conversation goes through a chain of matching strategies, and the first one that finds a compatible persona is used. • Location (288,196 conversations, 23.3%): the prompt names a place. Capitalized tokens and names after prepositions (e.g. “in Berlin”) are extracted with regular expressions and matched against each persona’s sub-region, country, native language and dialect; prompts in non-Latin scripts are also mapped to the countries and languages that use that script. • Semantic embedding (395,698, 32.0%): the first user message and each persona’s background and style are encoded with all-MiniLM-L6-v2 , and the most similar persona is chosen if its cosine similarity is at least 0.15. This pairs a prompt with a persona whose occupation or interests fit the topic. • Language pool (3,075, 0.2%): a fallback that only guarantees a persona who speaks the prompt’s language. • Cross-lingual (551,007, 44.5%): the separate cross-lingual mode, which ignores the prompt’s language and samples a persona from the whole bank. It produces the cross-lingual 44% of the corpus; without it, the language-matched set would stay almost entirely English.
blocks.zh: 每一个种子对话都经过一个匹配策略的链条,使用第一个找到相容人物的. • 地点(288 196个谈话,23.3%):即时名称。 以正常表达方式取出先入为主的符号和名称(如 " 在柏林 " ),并与每个人的分区域、国家、母语和方言相匹配;非拉丁文字的提示也绘制到使用该文字的国家和语言。 ·语义嵌入(395,698,32.0%):第一个用户消息和每个人a的背景和风格被编码为全-MiniLM-L6-v2,如果其同心弦相近性至少为0.15,则选择最相似的人a. 这与一个其职业或利益适合本专题的人同时出现。 语言库(3,075,0.2%):一个只保证说急切语言的人的倒数。 · 跨语种(551 007,44.5%):单独的跨语种模式,它忽略了当事者的语言,从全行抽取个人。 它产生44%的跨语言的教程;没有它,语言相匹配的套装将几乎完全保留英语.

blocks.en: Location (288,196 conversations, 23.3%): the prompt names a place. Capitalized tokens and names after prepositions (e.g. “in Berlin”) are extracted with regular expressions and matched against each persona’s sub-region, country, native language and dialect; prompts in non-Latin scripts are also mapped to the countries and languages that use that script.
blocks.zh: 地点(288,196个对话,23.3%):即时名称为一地. 以正常表达方式取出先入为主的符号和名称(如 " 在柏林 " ),并与每个人的分区域、国家、母语和方言相匹配;非拉丁文字的提示也绘制到使用该文字的国家和语言。

This pairs a prompt with a persona whose occupation or interests fit the topic.
blocks.zh: 语义嵌入(395,698,32.0%):第一个用户消息和每个人物的背景和风格被编码为全-MiniLM-L6-v2,如果其同位素相似性至少为0.15,则选择最相似的人. 这与一个其职业或利益适合本专题的人同时出现。

blocks.en: Language pool (3,075, 0.2%): a fallback that only guarantees a persona who speaks the prompt’s language.
blocks.zh: 语言库(3,075,0.2% ):一个只保证说急切语言的人的倒数。

blocks.en: Cross-lingual (551,007, 44.5%): the separate cross-lingual mode, which ignores the prompt’s language and samples a persona from the whole bank. It produces the cross-lingual 44% of the corpus; without it, the language-matched set would stay almost entirely English.
blocks.zh: 跨语种(551 007,44.5%):独立的跨语种模式,它忽略了当事者的语言,从全库中取出一个人物。 它产生44%的跨语言的教程;没有它,语言相匹配的套装将几乎完全保留英语.

blocks.en: Of the 1,606,837 conversations that reached the sanity gate, 1,267,306 (78.9%) pass every sanity check after the final assistant regeneration. After deduplication, a final filter on low-resource languages, a cap on cross-lingual Russian and a rule-based filter that removes 4,785 conversations in which a user turn restates the instructions of the rewrite prompt, 1,237,976 remain; these form the ≈ \approx 1.24M release we recommend for training. At the turn level, 93.3% of user turns pass (measured on the conversations with a model persona). Table 24 breaks the pass rate down, and two patterns stand out.
blocks.zh: 在到达疗养门的1,606,837次谈话中,1,267,306次(78.9%)在最后助理再生后通过每次疗养检查. 分解后,使用低资源语言的最终过滤器,跨语言俄语的封顶和基于规则的过滤器会去掉4,785个对话,其中用户转而重述重写快件的指示,仍保留了1,237,976个;这些组成了\\\大约1.24M版本,我们建议培训. 在转弯关卡,93.3%的用户转弯(根据与模特人的对话a衡量). 表24打破了通过率,有两个模式突出。

blocks.en: The first is the responder model. Gemma-4-31B passes 89.2% of its conversations and Ministral-3-14B 68.0%, so the smaller model accounts for about 74% of all dropped conversations. The seed source matters much less at this stage (UltraChat 82.1%, Nemotron 80.2%, WildChat 77.2%). The gap therefore reflects the responder’s capacity, not a problem with persona conditioning itself.
blocks.zh: 第一种是反应器模型. Gemma-4-31B通过其89.2%的对话和Ministryal-3-14B 68.0%,所以较小的模型占了所有掉入的对话的约74%. 在这一阶段,种子来源的重要性要小得多(UltraChat 82.1%,Nemotron 80.2%,WildChat 77.2%)。 因此,差距反映了反应者的能力,而不是人性调节的问题。

blocks.en: The second pattern is smaller. Cross-lingual conversations pass less often than language-matched ones (75.2% against 82.3%), as expected when the user writes in a language the responder handles less confidently. We keep both parts in the release rather than quietly dropping the harder one.
blocks.zh: 第二种模式较小. 与语言相匹配的对话(75.2%对82.3%)相比,跨文化对话的通过次数较少,如用户使用某种语言写作时,响应者处理的自信较低。 我们把两部分都放进去 而不是悄悄地放下更难的

blocks.en: Table 24: Sanity pass rates by slice (%). Conversation-level sanity pass of the final assistant regeneration over all 1,606,837 conversations that reached the gate; responder = the model that generated the conversation.
blocks.zh: 表24:按切片分列的卫生通过率(%)。 在到达大门的所有1,606,837个对话中,最终助理再生的谈话级疗养通过;应答者=生成对话的模型.

blocks.en: Personas carry a free-text dialect label: the whole bank has 117,670 distinct labels, and the personas used in the conversations carry 81,388 distinct labels after case and whitespace normalization, so the same dialect can be phrased differently across personas. We group them into canonical varieties per language and keep a variety only when it belongs to the language of the conversation, which leaves 13,714 varieties: 1,639 have at least 100 user turns, 416 have at least 1,000, and 695 are carried by at least 100 distinct personas. Frequent labels include regional varieties such as Northern English, New Zealand English and Swiss German. These counts describe the personas that condition the rewrites; verifying how faithfully each dialect is realized in text would require native speakers for each variety, which we leave to future work.
blocks.zh: Personas带有自由文字方言的标签:全库有117,670个有区别的标签,对话中使用的人物在大小写后有81,388个有区别的标签并实现白地平分化,因此同一方言可以被用不同的词来表达. 我们把每种语言归类为犬类品种,只保留属于对话语言的品种,留有13,714个品种:1,639个至少有100个用户转弯,416个至少有1000个,695个至少有100个不同的人携带. 常见的标签包括北英,新西兰英语和瑞士德语等区域品种. 这些数字说明了重写的条件;核实每种方言在文字中如何忠实地实现,要求每种语言都讲当地语言,我们留待今后工作。

blocks.en: We checked 20,000 WildChat-seeded rewrites with Presidio ( Microsoft, 2024 ) . Rewrites do not add contact details: none of the 10,550 same-language pairs introduces an email address, phone number or card number that is absent from its seed. Details already present in a WildChat seed can carry over (pattern-detected entities in 12.2% of seeds and 11.3% of rewrites), so this part of the corpus inherits WildChat’s own anonymization.
blocks.zh: 我们检查了两万个野生Chat种子 与Presidio(微软,2024年)的重写。 重写不添加联系方式:10,550对同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文同文 已经存在于WildChat种子中的细节可以继承(在12.2%的种子和11.3%的重写中被复制的实体),因此这部分内容继承了WildChat自己的匿名。

blocks.en: G.2 Assistant-Side Model Personas
blocks.zh: G.2 助理系统模型人物

blocks.en: This appendix documents the assistant-side model personas of Section 6 : the style set, how styles are matched and used, the data-level pilot that motivated their use, and a downstream fine-tuning ablation. All judged numbers come from a single LLM judge ( MiniMax-M2.5 ) and are proxies.
blocks.zh: 本附录记录了第6节的助手-侧式模型人物:样式集,样式的匹配和使用方式,促使其使用的数据级飞行员,下游微调衰减. 所有被判断的数字都来自单一的LLM法官(MiniMax-M2.5),并且是代理人.

blocks.en: Each of the 12 styles has a free-text description of how answers are presented, eight presentation axes (register, structure, density, warmth, explanation, jargon, certainty, emoji), two or three optional signature touches, and content safeguards (e.g. never drop a requested detail for brevity, never agree with an incorrect premise). Two rules hold for every style: keep every fact, step, number and requested detail the answer needs, and never invent facts, sources or statistics to fit the style. Table 25 lists the styles by their one-line summary together with their share of the release. Style names are used only for bookkeeping and never appear in a prompt. In a 1,000-conversation pilot, removing them from the prompt left style adoption (68.8% without names, 66.4% with) and judged fit (47.6 to 50.8 pairwise) unchanged within noise, and it removes any chance of a label leaking into the replies: 52 released conversations in which a reply named its own style were regenerated without names.
blocks.zh: 12个样式中每个样式都有自由文字描述如何呈现答案,8个呈现轴(注册,结构,密度,温暖,解释,用词,确定性,emoji),2个或3个可选的签名触点,以及内容保障(例如从不为简洁而放出所要求的细节,从不赞同错误的前提). 每种风格都有两条规则:保留每一个事实,台阶,数字和要求的详细答案需要,永远不要发明符合风格的事实,出处或统计. 表25按其一行摘要及其发行份额列出样式. 样式名称仅用于簿记,从未在提示中出现 。 在1000个对话试点中,将它们从即时左风格的采纳中去掉(68.8%没有名字,66.4%有名字),并在噪声中被判定为适合(47.6到50.8对),这消除了标签泄露到答复中的任何可能性:52个发布谈话中,一个名为自己风格的回音被重新生成而没有名字.

blocks.en: Table 25: The 12 assistant response styles (share in %), ordered by their share of the released corpus ( n = 234,723 n=234{,}723 conversations).
blocks.zh: 表25:12个助手响应风格(份额为%),按其在释放的被体中的份额订购(n=234,723 n=234{,}723个对话).

blocks.en: The matcher sees a reduced user card with the persona’s AI stance, digital fluency, sentence-length tendency, question framing, code-switching frequency and structured typing keys, together with the first user message; occupation, gender, age, location, languages and the free-text chatting style (which often names a language or region) are withheld, so the choice cannot key on demographics. Candidate styles are shown in a per-conversation random order, and the top-ranked style is used for the whole conversation. During assistant regeneration, the style section is appended to the paper’s persona system prompt on every turn, with an explicit priority order: explicit user instructions about format, length, tone or language first, then the content rules, correctness and safety, and only then the style. A signature touch is offered with p = 0.25 p=0.25 per reply (25.0% of released assistant turns), and the continuity adaptation step keeps the style. As with the user persona, neither the style nor its matching is stored in the training example. The match distribution is skewed (Table 25 ): the two most frequent styles cover 43% of conversations and the least frequent 1.5%.
blocks.zh: 匹配者看到一个减少的用户卡与人物的AI姿态,数字流畅,句子长度趋势,问题框架,代码切换频率和结构化打字键,以及第一个用户信息;职业,性别,年龄,位置,语言和自由文本聊天风格(通常为一种语言或地区取名)被扣去,因此选择不能在人口学上按键. 候选人风格按每个对话的随机顺序显示,最高排名的风格用于整个对话. 在助手再生期间,样式部分被附加在每转一转便被提示的纸上人物a系统上,并有明确的优先级顺序:关于格式,长度,语气或语言的明确的用户指示首先,然后是内容规则,正确性和安全性,然后是样式. 以p=0.25 p=0.25的每回回复(25.0%的已释放助手转身)提供签名触摸,连续性的适应步骤保持了风格. 与用户人物a一样,样式及其匹配均不存储在培训示例中. 配对分布扭曲(表25):两种最常见的风格覆盖了43%的对话和最不常见的1.5%.

blocks.en: Before settling on the release setup, we tested three design questions on 604 conversations (1,489 assistant turns) with an earlier version of the style set without signature touches (Table 26 ). Content agreement is measured against the reply generated with the user persona only; instruction compliance is measured on the 94 later turns with an explicit format or length instruction. First, matching carries signal : in a pairwise judgment of which reply suits the user better, the matched style beats a random style 60.0 to 39.9. Second, generating with the style beats restyling afterwards on adoption , while restyling an existing reply keeps its content almost perfectly; we generate with the style because the release regenerates the assistant side anyway, and keep restyling as an option for data whose answers must not change. Third, instruction compliance on later turns is unaffected in every arm within the precision of this sample. As in the main pilot, the matched style ties the user-persona-only reply on judged fit (49.7 to 50.1).
blocks.zh: 在决定发行设置之前,我们在604个对话中测试了三个设计问题(1,489个助手转弯),更早的版本的风格设定没有签名触碰(表26. 内容协议仅与用户个人生成的回复进行计量;指令遵守情况在94个后期转向中以明确的格式或长度指令进行计量。 首先,匹配带信号 : 在对复数更适合用户的双向判断中,匹配的样式会比随机样式60.0到39.9. 第二,用样式生成在收养后会击败休眠,而用现有回复的休眠令其内容几乎保持完美;我们用样式生成,因为释放会重新产生助手一方,并保持休眠作为数据的选择,其答案绝不能改变。 第三,以后转弯时的指令遵守情况在本样本的精确度范围内,每个臂都不受影响。 与主飞行员一样,匹配的样式将仅用户个人的回复与判定的合适(49.7至50.1)联系起来。

blocks.en: Table 26: Model persona design pilot (%, higher is better; bold: best per column). 604 conversations; content agreement vs. the user-persona-only reply; compliance on 94 turns with explicit instructions. 95% intervals at most ± \pm 2.5 (per-turn) and ± \pm 10 points (compliance).
blocks.zh: 表26:模型人物设计试点(%,较高者更好;粗体:每栏最好). 604个对话;内容协议与用户/人/只回复;94个回合遵守明确指示。 95%的间隔在 ±\pm 2.5 (每回转)和 ±\pm 10 个分(遵守) .

blocks.en: On 1,000 conversations with fixed user turns, we regenerate the assistant side four ways with the same responder per conversation and compare them (Table 27 ). Style adoption asks whether a reply is recognisably presented in the conversation’s matched style; for the default and background-only arms this measures how often the reply happens to fit that style anyway. Content agreement compares each reply with the default reply to the same turn; the noise floor, two independent default samples, is 59.6%. Instruction compliance is measured on later turns whose user message contains an explicit format or length instruction.
blocks.zh: 在与固定用户旋转的1000个对话中,我们用每一次对话中相同的响应者重新生成助手一方的四道并进行比较(表27. 风格化的收养询问,在对话的对应风格中,答复是否明显地被呈现出来;对于默认和仅以背景为背景的臂膀,衡量答复是否总是适合这种风格。 内容协议将每个回复与默认回复对比到同一个转弯;噪声地层,两个独立的默认样本,为59.6%. 指令的遵守程度在用户信息包含有明确格式或长度指令的后转会中进行测量.

blocks.en: Table 27: Data-level model persona pilot (%, except median words). 1,000 conversations, about 2,500 assistant turns, MiniMax-M2.5 judge; 95% intervals at most ± \pm 1.9 points for per-turn rates.
blocks.zh: 表27:数据级模型人物试点(%,中值词除外). 1000个对话,约2500个助手转会,MiniMax-M2.5裁判;每回转率的间隔为95%,最多为±\pm 1.9分.

blocks.en: The model persona makes the intended style clearly recognizable without reducing instruction compliance, and conditioning on the user persona shortens replies to about half the default length. In a pairwise judgment of which reply suits the user better, shown the reduced user card, the combination of user persona and model persona beats the default 61 to 39 and the model persona alone 58 to 41, but ties the user persona alone (49 to 51). The model persona therefore adds a controllable assistant style rather than a better fit to the user.
blocks.zh: 模型人物a使预期风格在不降低指令合规性的情况下清晰地被识别出,对用户人物的限定a将答复缩短到约一半的默认长度. 在对答更适合用户的双向判断中,显示用户卡的减少,用户人名和型号人名的组合击败了默认的61至39和型号人名单58至41,但将用户人名单连在一起(49至51). 因此,模型人物a增加了一种可控制的助手风格,而不是更适合用户.

blocks.en: We regenerate the assistant side of the corpus three ways with identical user turns: (A) no assistant system prompt, (B) the paper’s user-persona system prompt, and (C) the user persona plus a matched model persona, as in the release. We fine-tune Llama-3.1-8B (full fine-tuning, one epoch, learning rate 10 − 5 10^{-5} , global batch 128) and Apertus-8B-2509 ( Hernández-Cano et al., 2026 ) (base model, same budget, packed multi-turn sequences with loss on every assistant turn) on the same 100k conversations per arm. For evaluation, 300 held-out requests are each rewritten by 12 user personas that span digital fluency, AI stance, capitalization, message length and typos, so the request is fixed and only the user’s voice changes; replies are decoded greedily. We measure within-request correlations between a user-message feature and the matching reply feature, style diversity as the mean pairwise distance of the 12 replies to one request in a content-independent style embedding ( Wegmann et al., 2022 ) , content stability as LaBSE similarity to the reply given to the unstyled request, and a pairwise judge of which reply is presented better for the user, with a length-controlled (LC) win rate estimated at equal reply length by logistic regression on the log length ratio.
blocks.zh: 我们通过三种方式重新生成该实体的助手:A)没有助理系统即时,B)纸张的用户-人称系统即时,C)用户人称加上匹配的模型人称,如发布时那样。 我们微调了Llama-3.1-8B(全面微调,一个时代,学习率10−5 10^{-5},全球批量128)和Apertus-8B-2509(Hernández-Cano等,2026年)(基建模型,预算相同,多回合组合序列,每个助手回合损失),每臂对话100克。 就评价而言,每个有12名用户重新撰写了300份搁置请求,这些用户跨越数字流畅度、AI姿态、资本化、消息长度和打字,因此请求是固定的,只有用户的语音变化;答复是贪婪地解码的。 我们测量用户信息特性与匹配回复特性之间的请求内关联,样式多样性是12个对一个请求的答复在内容独立样式嵌入(Wegmann等,2022年)中的平均对等距离,内容稳定性是LaBSE与对未拼接请求的答复相似,一个对等的判断器对用户的答案比较好,长度控制(LC)胜率通过逻辑回归对日志长度比进行相等回复长度的估计.

blocks.en: Table 28: Adaptation to the user’s style after fine-tuning. Correlations are within-request (user-message feature to reply feature); diversity and stability as described in the text. Arms A to C as in the notation; IT is the instruction-tuned release.
blocks.zh: 表28:微调后适应用户风格. 关联性是请求内(用户信息特征用于回复特征);文本所描述的多样性和稳定性. 标记中的A至C武器;IT是指示调整的释放。

blocks.en: Table 29: Judge-free reply features after fine-tuning (headers, bullets and emoji: % of replies). Replies of the fine-tuned models to the style probes.
blocks.zh: 表29:微调后无法官回复功能(标题、子弹和emoji:答复百分比)。 微调模型对样式探测器的回复.

blocks.en: Table 30: Pairwise judge after fine-tuning (win rate of the first model, %). Raw win rate with 95% confidence interval and length-controlled (LC) win rate; about 3,500 decisive comparisons per pair.
blocks.zh: 表30:微调后的对等裁判(第一个模型的胜率,%). 原始取胜率以95%的置信间隔和长度控制(LC)取胜率;每对约3500个决定性比较.

blocks.en: Figure 27: Pairwise win rates after fine-tuning, raw (open) and length-controlled (filled).
blocks.zh: 图27:微调后平分取胜率,生(开)和长控取胜率(填).

blocks.en: Three observations follow (Tables 28 , 29 and 30 , Figure 27 ). Formality is the mean score of a formality classifier ( Babakov et al., 2023 ) . First, every model fine-tuned on persona-styled conversations tracks the user’s formality and emoji use far more than Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct , in both model families, and is clearly preferred over it. Second, without assistant conditioning (A) the models inherit the teacher’s defaults: replies two to two and a half times longer, headers in about three quarters of them, and the lowest style diversity. Conditioning the assistant (B, C) yields shorter, less formatted and more varied replies that the judge prefers, but the preference disappears or reverses once length is controlled; since B and C replies are about half as long, the equal-length estimate is an extrapolation. Third, the model persona does not beat the user-persona prompt on judged fit (a tie for Llama, B preferred for Apertus); its benefit is the controllable style variation of Table 27 , and downstream Llama C adapts length and emoji most and is the most diverse, while Apertus C is less diverse than Apertus B. These results use one seed per arm, a single judge and no capability benchmarks, and the fine-tuning data share the user side, so they compare assistant conditioning only.
blocks.zh: 下面是三项意见(表28、29和30,图27)。 形式是形式分类器的平均分(Babakov等,2023年). 首先,每个在人称对话上微调的模型都会跟踪用户的正则和emoji在两个模范家庭中使用远超过Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct的功能,并且明显比它更受青睐. 其次,没有助理条件(A)的模型继承了老师的默认:回复时间长了2到2.5倍,标题在其中大约四分之三,风格多样性最低. 附带条件的助手(B,C)产生更短,格式更简洁更多样的评委所喜欢的答复,但一旦长度得到控制,偏好就会消失或倒行逆施;由于B和C的答复大约是一半长,所以等长的估计是一种推算. 第三,模型人物a没有在判断出适合时击败用户-人物的快取(Llama的平分,B更喜欢Apertus);其好处是表27的可控风格变异,下游Llama C适应长度和emoji最多,也是最多样化的,而Apertus C的多取性不如Apertus B. 这些结果使用每只手臂一个种子,一个判断器,没有能力基准,而微调数据共享用户方,因此它们只比较助理条件.

blocks.en: Model personas do not depend on the user side, so they can also restyle the assistant side of an existing dataset. In this mode, the matcher sees only the user’s own messages (the first three), and the assistant turns are regenerated with the style section as the only system prompt, with the same continuity loop and sanity gate. On 1,000 source conversations (UltraChat and Nemotron, 2,570 assistant turns), matching succeeds for every conversation, and Table 31 compares the variants. Regeneration with the style raises style adoption from 25.7% to 79.5% at a cost of about five points of sanity pass; restyling the source replies afterwards keeps their content but reaches lower adoption and falls back to the original reply on 35% of turns because a protected span was lost.
blocks.zh: Model personas并不依赖于用户侧面,因此也可以重塑现有数据集的助手侧面. 在这种模式下,匹配者只看到用户自己的消息(前3个),助手转身会以样式部分作为唯一的系统提示再生成,具有相同的连续性回路和理智门. 在1000个源对话(UltraChat和Nemotron,2,570个助手转会)上,每个对话的匹配成功,表31比较了变体. 与风格相伴的再生将风格采纳率从25.7%提升至79.5%,花费了大约5分的理智通过;在事后重新整理来源回复时保留了内容,但达到较低的采纳率,并在35%的转折回原回复,因为一个受保护的跨度被丢失了.

blocks.en: Table 31: Model personas without a user persona (%, except median words; bold: best per column). 1,000 source conversations; content agreement of the first assistant turn vs. the source reply. 95% intervals at most ± \pm 1.9 (style) and ± \pm 3.1 points (other rates).
blocks.zh: 表31:没有用户名的模型人物a(%,中值词除外;粗体:每栏最好)。 1000个源对话;第一助手转会的内容一致与源回. 95%的间隔最高为±\\pm 1.9(样式)和±\pm 3.1分(其他速率).

blocks.en: A limitation of this mode appears when the source conversation carries its own system prompt. On 200 single-turn conversations with a checkable system constraint (at most three sentences, a numbered list, under 80 words, or no Markdown), compliance is 86% without a style, but 58% with the style placed below the system prompt and 66% with the system prompt placed last as an explicit override. The style competes with explicit format and length constraints even when told to yield, so conversations with a system prompt are left unaugmented.
blocks.zh: 当源头对话带有自己的系统提示时,会出现对这个模式的限制. 在200个带有可核对系统约束的单回合对话(多出3个句子,一个编号列表,在80个字以下,或没有Markdown)中,遵守率为86%,没有样式,但58%的样式放在系统下方,即时遵守,66%的系统即时遵守,即时遵守,即时执行,即时执行。 风格在明晰的格式和长度限制下竞争,即使在被告知要屈服时,因此与一个系统快件的对话会被置之不理.

blocks.en: G.3 Downstream Fine-tuning on the Released Corpus
blocks.zh: G.3 下游微调已释放体

blocks.en: The ablation above varies only the assistant side. Here we ask what the released conversations, with their persona-styled user turns, do for a model trained on them, and which part of the pipeline is responsible.
blocks.zh: 上面的废品只有助理一方不同. 在这里,我们询问所发布的对话, 与他们所谓的用户转身, 如何做一个模型 训练他们, 以及哪一部分管道负责。

blocks.en: We fine-tune Apertus-v1.5-8B base ( Project Apertus et al., 2026 ) for one epoch on four versions of the same 79,817 language-matched conversations from the training split, sampled with 5% of the personas held out for evaluation. The arms differ only in their turns: (A0) the original seed conversation; (A0r) the original user turns with the assistant turns regenerated by the same responder, with no persona, the same continuity loop and the same sanity gate; (A1) the persona-styled user turns with the original assistant turns; and (A2) the released conversation, with styled user turns and assistant turns regenerated for that user. Conversations whose A0r regeneration failed the sanity gate, or that exceed 3,800 tokens in any arm, are removed from all arms. Training uses Megatron-LM with packed 4,096-token sequences, loss on every assistant turn, global batch 128, and a learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} decayed to 10 − 6 10^{-6} with a cosine schedule after 3% warmup.
blocks.zh: 我们微调了Apertus-v1.5-8B基础(Project Apertus et al., 2026), 用于四个时代, 手臂只在转弯上有所不同:(A0)原始的种子对话; (A0r)原始的用户与助手转弯由同一位响应者重生,没有人a,相同的连续回路和相同的疗养门; (A1)人称的用户与原始助手转弯; (A2)释放的谈话,为该用户重生有名的用户转弯和助手转弯. 其A0r再生失败了疗养门的谈话,或任何臂上超过3,800个令牌的谈话,从所有臂上取出. 训练使用威震天-LM,装有4,096个托克序列,每个助手转弯都丢失了,全球第128批,学习速度为10 — 5 10 — 5 — 已衰变为10 — 6 10 — 6 — 6 — 3 % 后有余弦表。

blocks.en: We report clean capability with lm-evaluation-harness (thinking disabled), robustness as the drop from the clean prompt to a perturbed one on IFEval, GSM8K and MBPP, and a pairwise comparison on real user messages. Perturbations are either rule-based (lowercasing, punctuation removal, light and heavy typos, abbreviations, terse and combined variants) or persona rewrites of the benchmark prompt by three held-out personas ( Gemma-4-31B rewriter, kept only if MiniMax-M2.5 confirms that the task is unchanged, 99.6% of rewrites). For the pairwise comparison, we sample 1,000 first user turns from WildChat seeds that no arm was trained on (500 English, 500 in other languages); two judges from outside the pipeline ( Qwen3.6-35B-A3B , Muse-Glimmer-30B ) judge each pair of replies in both orders, and we report a length-controlled win rate as in Appendix G.2 . Intervals are 95% paired bootstrap intervals over items.
blocks.zh: 我们在IFEval、GSM8K和MBPP上报告清洁能力, 扰动要么是基于规则的(低调、平分去除、轻重打字、缩写、特克和合并变体),要么是由三个被扣出的人(Gemma-4-31B重写,只有在MiniMax-M2.5确认任务不变的情况下才保留)对基准进行重写,重写率为99.6%)。 为了进行对等比较,我们抽样抽取了1,000个来自野生Chat种子的首个用户,这些种子没有受过任何培训(500个英语,500个其他语言);两名来自管道外的法官(Qune3.6-35B-A3B,Muse-Glimer-30B)在两种顺序中判断每对答复,我们报告一个长控取胜率,如附录G.2。 间距为95%的对接靴子间隔。

blocks.en: Table 32: Clean capability after fine-tuning Apertus-v1.5-8B base on each arm (%, lm-evaluation-harness, thinking disabled). Mean over three training seeds (standard deviation at most 1.6 points). Median assistant-turn length of the training data in characters.
blocks.zh: 表32:每个臂上精细调整Apertus-v1.5-8B基后清洁能力(%,lm-asseration-harness,思维障碍). 平均超过3个培训种子(最高1.6分的标准偏差)。 以字符表示的训练数据中间助手-回合长度.

blocks.en: Table 33: Paired comparisons between arms , training seed 1234. IFEval strict accuracy scored with our IFEval checker, which also scores the perturbed prompts: difference on clean prompts and difference in the robustness gap (clean minus perturbed, positive: the first arm loses more), in points with 95% intervals over items; length-controlled (LC) WildChat win rate of the first arm (%) per judge.

blocks.en: Table 32 and Table 33 show three findings. First, styled user turns help only together with assistant turns written for them. Training on styled user turns with the original replies (A1) lowers IFEval against the original data, while the released conversations (A2) score highest on IFEval and clearly beat A1. The A2 advantage over A1 on IFEval holds across three training seeds (7.2, 6.5 and 3.3 points with lm-evaluation-harness; 5.7 [1.9, 9.6] with intervals over items and seeds), and on real WildChat prompts both external judges prefer A2 replies over A1 replies at equal length for every seed (57.3 to 60.0%). Second, the released conversations match or improve on the original data: against A0, A2 gains 1.8 points of IFEval strict accuracy on average over seeds and loses 3.1 points on GSM8K, the only benchmark where it is consistently behind, and both judges prefer A2 replies over A0 replies at equal length for every seed (54.6 to 57.5%). Third, none of the arms measurably changes robustness to messy prompts: rule-based gaps stay small for every arm, and no gap difference between arms excludes zero. Persona rewrites of benchmark prompts cost every arm more than rule-based noise. Regenerating the assistant side without a persona (A0r) more than doubles the reply length, so the comparisons against A0r depend on the length correction, and the two judges disagree on A2 against A0r at equal length for every seed. Over three training seeds, A2 gains 4.6 points [1.1, 8.2] of IFEval strict accuracy over A0r and A1 loses 3.8 points [ − - 6.7, − - 0.9] against A0 (lm-evaluation-harness, intervals over items and seeds). These results come from one base model.
blocks.zh: 表32和表33显示三项调查结果。 首先,风格化的用户只能与为他们撰写的助手转出帮助. 对有风格的用户进行与原始回复(A1)相对抗的培训会降低IFEval相对于原始数据,而所发布的对话(A2)则在IFEval上得分最高并明显击败了A1. IFEval上的A2优于A1,拥有三种训练种子(7.2,6.5分和3.3分有lm-评价-缺陷;5.7[1.9, 9.6]分有间隙的种子和种子),在真正的WildChat上,两个外部评委都倾向于A2答复,而每个种子的A1答复长度相同(57.3%至60.0%)。 其次,发布的对话匹配或改进了原始数据:与A0相比,A2平均获得1.8分的IFEval严格精度比种子高,并损失了3.1分的GSM8K,这是它一贯落后的唯一基准,两位评委都倾向于A2回复,而不是A0回复,每个种子的长度相同(54.6%至57.5%). 第三,没有任何武器可以明显地改变强性,变成杂乱无章的诱因:每个武器都保持有章可循的空白;武器之间没有任何差异排除了零。 Persona 重写基准提示 花费的每个手臂 都比规则的噪音要多。 在没有人(A0r)的情况下再生助手一面会比回执长度多出一倍多,因此与A0r的比较取决于长度的校正,两位评委对A2对A0r的评分各有相同长度. 超过3个训练种子,A2在A0r和A1上获得4.6分[1.1,8.2]的IFEval严格精度会比A0失去3.8分[−-6.7,−-0.9]对A0(lm-valuation-harness,时间间隔于物品和种子). 这些结果来自一个基本模型。

blocks.en: Retraining A2 only on conversations in which every user turn is labelled same request (Appendix C ), at equal size and with three seeds, leaves every benchmark unchanged (IFEval + + 0.3 [ − - 2.2, 2.8]), and the preference over the original data remains (53.8 to 57.4%).
blocks.zh: 重新培训A2只针对每个用户转弯时都标出相同要求(附录C),大小相同,并有3个种子,每个基准(IFEval + + 0.3 [−- 2.2, 2.8])保持不变,而相对于原始数据,偏好仍然存在(53.8%至57.4%).

blocks.en: We sent 300 held-out requests from 12 user personas (three seeds) to models trained on our data (A2) and on the original data (A0). A2 adapts its reply style to the user more, while content stays as stable (Table 34 ). This controlled study is our main downstream evidence; the comparison with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct in Appendix G.2 is context only.
blocks.zh: 我们向接受过数据(A2)和原始数据(A0)培训的模型发送了来自12个用户(3个种子)的300份搁置请求。 A2更能适应用户的回复风格,而内容保持稳定(表34. 这一受控研究是我们下游的主要证据;附录G.2中与Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct的比较只是上下文.

blocks.en: Table 34: Adaptation of reply style after fine-tuning on the released (A2) and original (A0) conversations, 300 held-out requests from 12 user personas, three seeds.
blocks.zh: 表34:在对发布(A2)和原创(A0)对话进行微调后调整回复样式,12名用户的300个被搁置请求,3个种子.

blocks.en: We repeat the comparison for the cross-lingual setting with two arms built from the same English seeds and target personas: (X1) every user turn translated into the persona’s language by the pipeline’s persona-blind translation step, with the assistant turns regenerated without a persona as in A0r; and (X2) the released cross-lingual conversation, with styled user turns and assistant turns regenerated for that user. Conversations whose X1 translation or regeneration failed, or that exceed 3,800 tokens in either arm, are removed from both, leaving 40,528 conversations; training follows the setup above with one seed. Table 35 adds multilingual benchmarks. X2 is ahead on most benchmarks, with the largest gain on multilingual instruction following (Multi-IF, 7.3 points), and behind on GSM8K. On WildChat prompts, X2 replies are half as long as X1 replies; both judges prefer X2 on raw votes, but at equal length Muse is at parity (52.1%, interval 48.0 to 55.9) and Qwen3.6 prefers X1 (44.3%, interval 40.7 to 47.9), so the open-ended comparison is inconclusive given the large length difference.
blocks.zh: 我们重复使用从同一个英文种子和目标人物所建的两条臂来比较交叉语言的设置:(X1)每个用户通过管道的人格盲翻译步骤将翻译为人物语言,助手会像A0r一样在没有人物的情况下再生成;和(X2)释放的交叉语言对话,有名的用户转动和助手会为该用户再生成. 其X1翻译或再生失败,或两个臂上超过3800个令牌的谈话被移除,留下了40,528个对话;训练遵循上面的设置并有一个种子. 表35增加了多语种基准。 X2在大多数基准方面领先,在多语种教学方面收益最大,其次是多语种教育(多语种教育框架,7.3分),其次是GSM8K。 在"WildChat points"上,X2的回复与X1的回复是一半;两位法官在生票上偏好X2,但同样长度的Muse是等价的(52.1%,间隔48.0至55.9),而Qune3.6则偏好X1(44.3%,间隔40.7至47.9),因此鉴于长度相差很大,开放式的比较没有定论.
